ko.title: 전쟁의 대가: 이란 갈등 비용이 국방 예산과 적자를 재편하는 방식

segments.src: ## Why the Bill Matters
segments.tr: ## 청구서가 중요한 이유

segments.src: Every military operation comes with a price tag, and the final total is rarely the number first discussed.
segments.tr: 모든 군사 작전에는 비용이 따르며, 최종 합계가 처음 논의된 금액인 경우는 거의 없습니다.

segments.src: Flying aircraft, keeping ships at sea, moving troops and running air defenses all cost money.
segments.tr: 항공기를 운항하고, 해상에 함정을 유지하며, 부대를 이동시키고 방공망을 가동하는 데는 모두 돈이 듭니다.

segments.src: So does replacing the weapons that get used.
segments.tr: 사용된 무기를 교체하는 것도 마찬가지입니다.

segments.src: When a conflict involving Iran draws in U.S.
segments.tr: 이란이 개입된 갈등에 U.S.

segments.src: forces or U.S.
segments.tr: 군대나 U.S.

segments.src: partners, those costs move from military planning documents into a budget debate in Washington.
segments.tr: 파트너가 말려들면, 이러한 비용은 군사 계획 문서에서 워싱턴의 예산 논쟁으로 이동합니다.

segments.src: This article does not try to predict how any conflict will unfold.
segments.tr: 이 기사는 갈등이 어떻게 전개될지 예측하려 하지 않습니다.

segments.src: It looks at the main categories of cost, how Congress usually pays for them, and why the timing is hard.
segments.tr: 이 기사는 비용의 주요 범주, 의회가 일반적으로 이에 대금을 지불하는 방식, 그리고 왜 시기 결정이 어려운지 살펴봅니다.

segments.src: Federal borrowing is already high, and lawmakers are already divided over what to prioritize.
segments.tr: 연방 차입금은 이미 높으며, 의원들은 어떤 것에 우선순위를 둘지를 두고 이미 분열되어 있습니다.

segments.src: ## The Three Big Cost Buckets
segments.tr: ## 3대 비용 범주

segments.src: ### 1. Operations
segments.tr: ### 1. 작전 비용

segments.src: Operating costs are the day-to-day expenses of a deployment.
segments.tr: 작전 비용은 파병 시 발생하는 일상적인 지출입니다.

segments.src: They include fuel, maintenance, flight hours, personnel pay and allowances, logistics and intelligence support.
segments.tr: 여기에는 연료, 정비, 비행 시간, 인건비 및 수당, 물류 및 정보 지원이 포함됩니다.

segments.src: Ships and aircraft that stay deployed longer than planned wear out faster.
segments.tr: 계획보다 오래 배치되는 함정과 항공기는 더 빨리 마모됩니다.

segments.src: That raises maintenance needs and can shorten the time before major repairs are due.
segments.tr: 이는 정비 수요를 늘리고 대규모 수리 주기까지의 시간을 단축할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Operating costs tend to grow with duration.
segments.tr: 작전 비용은 기간에 따라 증가하는 경향이 있습니다.

segments.src: A short, limited operation may be absorbed within existing accounts.
segments.tr: 단기의 제한적인 작전은 기존 계정 내에서 흡수될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: A prolonged presence usually is not.
segments.tr: 장기적인 주둔은 보통 그렇지 못합니다.

segments.src: At that point the Pentagon often asks Congress for additional funds.
segments.tr: 이 시점에서 펜타곤은 종종 의회에 추가 자금을 요청합니다.

segments.src: ### 2. Munitions Replenishment
segments.tr: ### 2. 탄약 보충

segments.src: The second bucket is often the hardest to fix quickly.
segments.tr: 두 번째 범주는 종종 신속하게 해결하기 가장 어려운 부분입니다.

segments.src: Interceptors, precision-guided weapons and long-range missiles are expensive.
segments.tr: 요격 미사일, 정밀 유도 무기 및 장거리 미사일은 비쌉니다.

segments.src: They are also built by a small number of manufacturers on production lines that cannot simply be sped up.
segments.tr: 또한 이들은 생산 라인을 단순히 증속할 수 없는 소수의 제조업체에서 생산됩니다.

segments.src: Defensive systems illustrate the problem.
segments.tr: 방어 시스템이 이 문제를 잘 보여줍니다.

segments.src: An interceptor used to stop an incoming threat can cost far more than the threat itself.
segments.tr: 다가오는 위협을 저지하는 데 사용되는 요격 미사일은 위협 자체보다 훨씬 더 비쌀 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Even when the exchange succeeds, the stockpile shrinks.
segments.tr: 교전에 성공하더라도 비축량은 줄어듭니다.

segments.src: Rebuilding it takes time, and the money has to be committed years ahead through multiyear contracts, factory expansion and supplier support.
segments.tr: 이를 다시 재건하는 데는 시간이 걸리며, 다년간 계약, 공장 확장 및 공급업체 지원을 통해 수년 전에 예산이 투입되어야 합니다.

segments.src: Analysts have repeatedly warned that U.S.
segments.tr: 분석가들은 U.S.

segments.src: stockpiles of some key munitions are under strain from several demands at once.
segments.tr: 의 일부 핵심 탄약 비축량이 여러 수요로 인해 동시에 압박을 받고 있다고 거듭 경고해 왔습니다.

segments.src: Those demands include support for partners and the need to stay ready for other regions.
segments.tr: 이러한 수요에는 파트너 지원과 다른 지역에 대한 대비 태세 유지 필요성이 포함됩니다.

segments.src: A conflict that uses these weapons heavily could turn that strain into an urgent funding request.
segments.tr: 이러한 무기를 다량 소모하는 갈등은 이 압박을 긴급 자금 요청으로 전환시킬 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ### 3. Energy and Economic Spillovers
segments.tr: ### 3. 에너지 및 경제적 파급 효과

segments.src: The third bucket is less visible in the defense budget but can matter just as much to households.
segments.tr: 세 번째 범주는 국방 예산에서 덜 눈에 띄지만 가계에는 마찬가지로 중요할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: The Middle East is central to global oil and gas flows, and any threat to shipping lanes or production can raise energy prices.
segments.tr: 중동은 세계 석유 및 가스 수송의 중심지이며, 수송로나 생산에 대한 위협은 에너지 가격을 상승시킬 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Higher fuel costs affect:
segments.tr: 연료비 상승은 다음에 영향을 미칩니다:

segments.src: - **The military itself**, which is one of the largest single energy consumers in the federal government.
segments.tr: - **군 자체**, 연방 정부에서 가장 큰 단일 에너지 소비처 중 하나입니다.

segments.src: - **Consumers**, who may see the effect at the pump and in transportation and shipping costs.
segments.tr: - **소비자**, 주유소 가격과 운송 및 물류 비용에서 그 영향을 느낄 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Inflation and interest rates**, which in turn influence the government's own borrowing costs.
segments.tr: - **인플레이션과 금리**, 결과적으로 정부 자체의 차입 비용에 영향을 미칩니다.

segments.src: These effects are difficult to forecast and can fade quickly or persist, depending on events.
segments.tr: 이러한 효과는 예측하기 어렵고 사태 전개에 따라 빠르게 사라질 수도, 지속될 수도 있습니다.

segments.src: They are still part of the real cost of a conflict, even though they never appear on a Pentagon spreadsheet.
segments.tr: 펜타곤 스프레드시트에 전혀 나타나지 않더라도 이는 여전히 분쟁이 가져오는 실제 비용의 일부입니다.

segments.src: ## How Congress Pays for War
segments.tr: ## 의회가 전쟁 비용을 대는 방식

segments.src: Congress has several ways to fund military action, and each has trade-offs.
segments.tr: 의회가 군사 행동에 자금을 대는 방법은 여러 가지가 있으며, 각 방법에는 상충 관계가 있습니다.

segments.src: - **The regular defense appropriations bill.** This is the most transparent route, but it competes directly with every other priority under spending limits.
segments.tr: - **정례 국방 세출 법안.** 가장 투명한 경로이지만 지출 한도 내에서 다른 모든 우선순위 항목과 직접 경쟁합니다.

segments.src: - **Supplemental appropriations.** These are emergency requests passed outside the regular process. They can move quickly, but they are often debated as stand-alone packages and can attract unrelated demands.
segments.tr: - **긴급 추가 경정 예산.** 정례 절차 밖에서 통과되는 긴급 요청입니다. 신속하게 진행될 수 있지만 단독 패키지로 논의되는 경우가 많아 관련 없는 요구사항이 첨부될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Overseas contingency-style accounts.** In past conflicts, designating funds as emergency or war-related allowed spending to sit outside normal budget caps. Critics have argued that this approach can blur the line between true war costs and routine expenses.
segments.tr: - **해외 우발사태(OCO) 방식의 계정.** 과거 갈등에서는 자금을 긴급 또는 전쟁 관련으로 지정하여 일반 예산 상한선 외부에서 지출할 수 있게 했습니다. 비판론자들은 이 접근법이 진정한 전쟁 비용과 일상 지출 사이의 경계를 흐릴 수 있다고 지적해 왔습니다.

segments.src: Which route lawmakers choose has real consequences.
segments.tr: 의원들이 어떤 경로를 선택하느냐는 실질적인 결과를 가져옵니다.

segments.src: Emergency designations can ease pressure on other programs, but they also add to the deficit without an offset.
segments.tr: 긴급 지정을 이용하면 다른 프로그램에 대한 압박을 완화할 수 있지만, 상쇄 조치 없이 적자를 늘리게 됩니다.

segments.src: Funding through the regular process forces trade-offs that some members would rather avoid.
segments.tr: 정례 절차를 통한 자금 조달은 일부 의원들이 회피하고 싶어 하는 양보와 타협을 강제합니다.

segments.src: ## The Deficit Collision
segments.tr: ## 재정 적자와의 충돌

segments.src: War funding does not arrive in an empty room.
segments.tr: 전쟁 자금 요청은 빈 공간에 도달하지 않습니다.

segments.src: The federal government is running large annual deficits, and interest payments on the national debt have become one of the fastest-growing parts of the budget.
segments.tr: 연방 정부는 이미 막대한 연간 적자를 내고 있으며, 국가 부채에 대한 이자 지급은 예산에서 가장 빠르게 증가하는 부분 중 하나가 되었습니다.

segments.src: In that setting, any new spending request raises a familiar question: should it be paid for, or added to the debt?
segments.tr: 이러한 상황에서 새로운 지출 요청은 낯익은 질문을 던집니다. 비용을 다른 곳에서 상쇄해야 하는가, 아니면 부채에 추가해야 하는가?

segments.src: Deficit-minded lawmakers may argue that new defense spending should be offset with cuts or revenue elsewhere.
segments.tr: 재정 적자를 의식하는 의원들은 새로운 국방 지출이 다른 분야의 감축이나 세수 증대로 상쇄되어야 한다고 주장할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Defense advocates may reply that national security needs cannot wait for a budget deal, and that delay can cost more in the long run.
segments.tr: 국방 옹호자들은 국가 안보 필요성이 예산 합의를 기다릴 수 없으며 지연되면 장기적으로 더 큰 비용이 들 수 있다고 반박할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Both arguments have a long history in Congress, and neither side wins automatically.
segments.tr: 두 주장 모두 의회에서 오랜 역사를 가지고 있으며, 어느 쪽도 자동으로 승리하지 않습니다.

segments.src: The result is often a negotiation in which several groups hold leverage at once:
segments.tr: 그 결과는 종종 여러 집단이 동시에 영향력을 행사하는 협상으로 이어집니다:

segments.src: 1. **Defense hawks** who want faster and larger investments in munitions and readiness.
segments.tr: 1. 탄약 및 대비 태세에 대한 더 빠르고 더 큰 투자를 원하는 **국방 강경파**.

segments.src: 2. **Fiscal conservatives** who want offsets or lower overall spending.
segments.tr: 2. 지출 상쇄 또는 전체 지출 축소를 원하는 **재정 보수파**.

segments.src: 3. **Appropriators of both parties** who want to protect domestic programs, infrastructure and aid to their districts.
segments.tr: 3. 국내 프로그램, 인프라 및 자치구 지원을 보호하려는 **양당의 세출위원회 위원들**.

segments.src: 4. **Members skeptical of military involvement** who may use the budget as a way to question the mission itself.
segments.tr: 4. 예산을 작전 자체에 회의를 제기하는 수단으로 사용할 수 있는 **군사 개입 회의론자 의원들**.

segments.src: ## Competing Priorities
segments.tr: ## 경합하는 우선순위들

segments.src: A war supplemental rarely travels alone.
segments.tr: 전쟁 추가 경정 예산안이 단독으로 다루어지는 경우는 드뭅니다.

segments.src: Other items often compete for attention at the same time, including aid to allies, border and security funding, disaster relief, and domestic priorities that members want to attach to a must-pass bill.
segments.tr: 동맹국 지원, 국경 및 안보 자금, 재난 구호, 의원들이 반드시 통과시켜야 하는 법안에 첨부하고자 하는 국내 우선 과제 등 다른 항목들이 동시에 관심을 끌기 위해 경쟁하곤 합니다.

segments.src: The more items in a package, the harder it is to build a majority, but the more reasons different members have to vote yes.
segments.tr: 패키지에 포함된 항목이 많을수록 과반수를 확보하기는 어려워지지만, 다양한 의원들이 찬성표를 던질 명분은 늘어납니다.

segments.src: There are also longer-term defense questions.
segments.tr: 장기적인 국방 관련 과제들도 존재합니다.

segments.src: Shipbuilding, aircraft modernization, missile defense and the industrial base all need sustained funding.
segments.tr: 조선, 항공기 현대화, 미사일 방어 및 방위 산업 기반 모두 지속적인 자금 지원이 필요합니다.

segments.src: If a conflict absorbs a large share of available money, some of those long-term programs could be delayed or scaled back.
segments.tr: 갈등으로 인해 가용 자금의 큰 부분이 소모되면 이러한 장기 프로그램 중 일부는 지연되거나 축소될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: If instead Congress treats the conflict as a reason to spend more overall, the deficit pressure grows.
segments.tr: 반대로 의회가 이 갈등을 전반적인 지출을 늘리는 명분으로 삼는다면 적자 압박은 더욱 커집니다.

segments.src: ## What to Watch
segments.tr: ## 주시해야 할 사항

segments.src: For readers trying to follow the debate, a few indicators are useful:
segments.tr: 논쟁의 흐름을 파악하려는 독자들에게는 몇 가지 지표가 유용합니다:

segments.src: - **The size and structure of any funding request**, including whether it is labeled emergency spending.
segments.tr: - **자금 요청의 규모와 구조**, 긴급 지출로 분류되는지 여부를 포함합니다.

segments.src: - **Whether munitions funding includes multiyear contracts**, which signal a longer-term rebuilding effort rather than a one-time refill.
segments.tr: - **탄약 자금 조달에 다년 계약이 포함되는지 여부**, 이는 일회성 충전이 아닌 장기적인 재건 노력을 나타냅니다.

segments.src: - **Cost estimates from independent sources**, such as the Congressional Budget Office and nonpartisan think tanks, which often differ from administration figures.
segments.tr: - 의회예산처(CBO) 및 비당파적 싱크탱크와 같은 **독립적인 출처의 비용 추정치**, 이는 행정부 수치와 다를 때가 많습니다.

segments.src: - **Energy market movements**, which can indicate whether the economic side of the conflict is growing.
segments.tr: - **에너지 시장의 움직임**, 분쟁의 경제적 파급력이 커지고 있는지 여부를 보여줄 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Statements on offsets**, which show how willing leaders are to pair new spending with cuts or revenue.
segments.tr: - **지출 상쇄에 대한 성명**, 지도부가 새로운 지출을 감축이나 세수 증대와 결합할 의향이 얼마나 되는지 보여줍니다.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 요약

segments.src: The cost of a conflict is more than the first number in a headline.
segments.tr: 분쟁 비용은 헤드라인의 첫 번째 숫자 이상입니다.

segments.src: It combines operating expenses, the long and expensive work of rebuilding stockpiles, and economic effects that reach well beyond the military.
segments.tr: 여기에는 작전 비용, 비축량을 재건하는 길고 비싼 작업, 그리고 군대를 넘어 멀리까지 미치는 경제적 효과가 결합되어 있습니다.

segments.src: How Congress responds will depend on how long events last, how lawmakers weigh security against borrowing, and whether the parties can agree on what to fund and how.
segments.tr: 의회가 어떻게 대응할지는 사태의 지속 기간, 의원들이 안보와 차입금을 어떻게 저울질하는지, 그리고 양당이 무엇에 어떻게 자금을 대는지에 합의할 수 있는지에 달려 있습니다.

segments.src: Whatever the outcome, the debate is likely to shape defense budgets and deficit discussions for years.
segments.tr: 결과가 어떻든 이 논쟁은 향후 몇 년간 국방 예산과 적자 논의를 형성할 가능성이 높습니다.

segments.src: Readers who want to understand it should look past the headline total and ask what the money buys, who decides, and who ultimately pays.

zh.title: 战争的代价：伊朗冲突成本如何重塑国防预算与赤字

segments.src: ## Why the Bill Matters
segments.tr: ## 为什么账单至关重要

segments.src: Every military operation comes with a price tag, and the final total is rarely the number first discussed.
segments.tr: 每一项军事行动都有其价格标签，而最终的总费用很少是最初讨论的那个数字。

segments.src: Flying aircraft, keeping ships at sea, moving troops and running air defenses all cost money.
segments.tr: 出动飞机、维持舰队巡航、调动部队以及运行防空系统都需要花钱。

segments.src: So does replacing the weapons that get used.
segments.tr: 补充消耗的武器也是如此。

segments.src: When a conflict involving Iran draws in U.S.
segments.tr: 当涉及伊朗的冲突卷入美

segments.src: forces or U.S.
segments.tr: 军或美

segments.src: partners, those costs move from military planning documents into a budget debate in Washington.
segments.tr: 国的盟友时，这些成本就会从军事规划文件中转移到华盛顿的预算辩论中。

segments.src: This article does not try to predict how any conflict will unfold.
segments.tr: 本文并不试图预测任何冲突将如何发展。

segments.src: It looks at the main categories of cost, how Congress usually pays for them, and why the timing is hard.
segments.tr: 它着眼于成本的主要类别、国会通常如何为其支付费用，以及为什么确定时间节点如此困难。

segments.src: Federal borrowing is already high, and lawmakers are already divided over what to prioritize.
segments.tr: 联邦借贷规模已经居高不下，而立法者在优先事项上也已分歧重重。

segments.src: ## The Three Big Cost Buckets
segments.tr: ## 三大主要成本板块

segments.src: ### 1. Operations
segments.tr: ### 1. 军事行动成本

segments.src: Operating costs are the day-to-day expenses of a deployment.
segments.tr: 运行成本是部署过程中的日常开支。

segments.src: They include fuel, maintenance, flight hours, personnel pay and allowances, logistics and intelligence support.
segments.tr: 它们包括燃料、维护、飞行小时数、人员薪饷和补贴、后勤以及情报支持。

segments.src: Ships and aircraft that stay deployed longer than planned wear out faster.
segments.tr: 部署时间超出计划的舰艇和飞机磨损得更快。

segments.src: That raises maintenance needs and can shorten the time before major repairs are due.
segments.tr: 这增加了维护需求，并可能缩短需要进行大修的时间周期。

segments.src: Operating costs tend to grow with duration.
segments.tr: 运行成本往往随着持续时间的延长而增加。

segments.src: A short, limited operation may be absorbed within existing accounts.
segments.tr: 短期、有限的行动可能会在现有账户中被吸收。

segments.src: A prolonged presence usually is not.
segments.tr: 长期存在通常则不然。

segments.src: At that point the Pentagon often asks Congress for additional funds.
segments.tr: 届时五角大楼往往会向国会申请额外资金。

segments.src: ### 2. Munitions Replenishment
segments.tr: ### 2. 弹药补充

segments.src: The second bucket is often the hardest to fix quickly.
segments.tr: 第二个板块往往是最难迅速解决的。

segments.src: Interceptors, precision-guided weapons and long-range missiles are expensive.
segments.tr: 拦截弹、精准制导武器和远程导弹价格昂贵。

segments.src: They are also built by a small number of manufacturers on production lines that cannot simply be sped up.
segments.tr: 它们也由极少数制造商在无法简单提速的生产线上制造。

segments.src: Defensive systems illustrate the problem.
segments.tr: 防御系统凸显了这一问题。

segments.src: An interceptor used to stop an incoming threat can cost far more than the threat itself.
segments.tr: 用于拦截来袭威胁的拦截弹成本可能远高于威胁本身。

segments.src: Even when the exchange succeeds, the stockpile shrinks.
segments.tr: 即使拦截成功，库存也会减少。

segments.src: Rebuilding it takes time, and the money has to be committed years ahead through multiyear contracts, factory expansion and supplier support.
segments.tr: 重建库存需要时间，而且必须通过多年期合同、工厂扩建和供应商支持提前数年投入资金。

segments.src: Analysts have repeatedly warned that U.S.
segments.tr: 分析人士屡次发出警告，称美

segments.src: stockpiles of some key munitions are under strain from several demands at once.
segments.tr: 军某些关键弹药的库存正同时受到多方需求的压力。

segments.src: Those demands include support for partners and the need to stay ready for other regions.
segments.tr: 这些需求包括对伙伴国家的支持，以及保持对其他地区战备状态的需要。

segments.src: A conflict that uses these weapons heavily could turn that strain into an urgent funding request.
segments.tr: 大量消耗这些武器的冲突可能会将这种紧张状况转变为紧急拨款请求。

segments.src: ### 3. Energy and Economic Spillovers
segments.tr: ### 3. 能源与经济溢出效应

segments.src: The third bucket is less visible in the defense budget but can matter just as much to households.
segments.tr: 第三个板块在国防预算中不太明显，但对普通家庭可能同样重要。

segments.src: The Middle East is central to global oil and gas flows, and any threat to shipping lanes or production can raise energy prices.
segments.tr: 中东对全球石油和天然气流动至关重要，对航运要道或生产的任何威胁都可能推高能源价格。

segments.src: Higher fuel costs affect:
segments.tr: 较高的燃料成本会影响：

segments.src: - **The military itself**, which is one of the largest single energy consumers in the federal government.
segments.tr: - **军队本身**，它是联邦政府中最大的单一能源消耗者之一。

segments.src: - **Consumers**, who may see the effect at the pump and in transportation and shipping costs.
segments.tr: - **消费者**，他们可能会在加油站以及运输和邮寄成本中感受到这种影响。

segments.src: - **Inflation and interest rates**, which in turn influence the government's own borrowing costs.
segments.tr: - **通货膨胀和利率**，这反过来又会影响政府自身的借贷成本。

segments.src: These effects are difficult to forecast and can fade quickly or persist, depending on events.
segments.tr: 这些效应难以预测，根据事态发展，它们可能会迅速消退，也可能会持续存在。

segments.src: They are still part of the real cost of a conflict, even though they never appear on a Pentagon spreadsheet.
segments.tr: 尽管它们从未出现在五角大楼的预算表格上，但它们仍属于冲突的实际成本的一部分。

segments.src: ## How Congress Pays for War
segments.tr: ## 国会如何为战争买单

segments.src: Congress has several ways to fund military action, and each has trade-offs.
segments.tr: 国会有几种为军事行动提供资金的方式，每种方式都有权衡取舍。

segments.src: - **The regular defense appropriations bill.** This is the most transparent route, but it competes directly with every other priority under spending limits.
segments.tr: - **常规国防拨款法案。** 这是最透明的途径，但它在支出限额下直接与所有其他优先事项竞争。

segments.src: - **Supplemental appropriations.** These are emergency requests passed outside the regular process. They can move quickly, but they are often debated as stand-alone packages and can attract unrelated demands.
segments.tr: - **补充拨款。** 这些是在常规程序之外通过的紧急请求。它们可以快速推进，但往往作为独立方案进行辩论，并可能吸引无关的要求。

segments.src: - **Overseas contingency-style accounts.** In past conflicts, designating funds as emergency or war-related allowed spending to sit outside normal budget caps. Critics have argued that this approach can blur the line between true war costs and routine expenses.
segments.tr: - **海外应急类账户。** 在过去的冲突中，将资金指定为紧急或与战争相关，允许开支置于正常预算上限之外。批评者主张，这种做法可能会模糊真实战争成本与日常开支之间的界限。

segments.src: Which route lawmakers choose has real consequences.
segments.tr: 立法者选择哪种途径会带来实际后果。

segments.src: Emergency designations can ease pressure on other programs, but they also add to the deficit without an offset.
segments.tr: 指定为紧急开支可以减轻对其他项目的压力，但它们也会在没有抵消措施的情况下增加赤字。

segments.src: Funding through the regular process forces trade-offs that some members would rather avoid.
segments.tr: 通过常规程序提供资金会迫使做出一些议员宁愿避免的权衡取舍。

segments.src: ## The Deficit Collision
segments.tr: ## 赤字碰撞

segments.src: War funding does not arrive in an empty room.
segments.tr: 战争资金的申请并非出现在真空环境中。

segments.src: The federal government is running large annual deficits, and interest payments on the national debt have become one of the fastest-growing parts of the budget.
segments.tr: 联邦政府正面临巨额的年度赤字，而国家债务的利息支付已成为预算中增长最快的部分之一。

segments.src: In that setting, any new spending request raises a familiar question: should it be paid for, or added to the debt?
segments.tr: 在这种背景下，任何新的支出请求都会引发一个熟悉的问题：是应该为其寻找对冲资金，还是直接计入债务？

segments.src: Deficit-minded lawmakers may argue that new defense spending should be offset with cuts or revenue elsewhere.
segments.tr: 关注赤字的立法者可能会主张，新的国防开支应该通过削减其他方面的开支或增加收入来抵消。

segments.src: Defense advocates may reply that national security needs cannot wait for a budget deal, and that delay can cost more in the long run.
segments.tr: 国防倡导者可能会回应说，国家安全需求不能等待预算协议，而且拖延在长远来看可能会付出更大代价。

segments.src: Both arguments have a long history in Congress, and neither side wins automatically.
segments.tr: 这两种主张在国会都有悠久的历史，任何一方都无法自动获胜。

segments.src: The result is often a negotiation in which several groups hold leverage at once:
segments.tr: 其结果往往是一场博弈，多个群体同时握有筹码：

segments.src: 1. **Defense hawks** who want faster and larger investments in munitions and readiness.
segments.tr: 1. **鹰派国防议员**，他们希望更快、更大规模地投资于弹药和战备。

segments.src: 2. **Fiscal conservatives** who want offsets or lower overall spending.
segments.tr: 2. **财政保守派**，他们希望提供对冲抵消措施或降低总体支出。

segments.src: 3. **Appropriators of both parties** who want to protect domestic programs, infrastructure and aid to their districts.
segments.tr: 3. **两党拨款委员会成员**，他们希望保护国内项目、基础设施以及对其选区的援助。

segments.src: 4. **Members skeptical of military involvement** who may use the budget as a way to question the mission itself.
segments.tr: 4. **对军事干预持怀疑态度的议员**，他们可能会利用预算作为质疑任务本身的一种手段。

segments.src: ## Competing Priorities
segments.tr: ## 互相竞争的优先事项

segments.src: A war supplemental rarely travels alone.
segments.tr: 战争补充拨款法案很少单独出台。

segments.src: Other items often compete for attention at the same time, including aid to allies, border and security funding, disaster relief, and domestic priorities that members want to attach to a must-pass bill.
segments.tr: 其他项目往往会同时争夺注意力，包括对盟友的援助、边境和安全资金、灾害救援以及议员们希望附加到必须通过的法案上的国内优先事项。

segments.src: The more items in a package, the harder it is to build a majority, but the more reasons different members have to vote yes.
segments.tr: 一个方案中的项目越多，建立多数支持就越难，但不同议员投票赞成的理由也越多。

segments.src: There are also longer-term defense questions.
segments.tr: 还有更长期的高层国防问题。

segments.src: Shipbuilding, aircraft modernization, missile defense and the industrial base all need sustained funding.
segments.tr: 造船、飞机现代化、导弹防御和工业基础都需要持续的资金支持。

segments.src: If a conflict absorbs a large share of available money, some of those long-term programs could be delayed or scaled back.
segments.tr: 如果一场冲突占用了大部分可用资金，其中一些长期项目可能会被推迟或缩减规模。

segments.src: If instead Congress treats the conflict as a reason to spend more overall, the deficit pressure grows.
segments.tr: 反之，如果国会把冲突作为增加总体支出的理由，赤字压力就会加大。

segments.src: ## What to Watch
segments.tr: ## 需要关注的要点

segments.src: For readers trying to follow the debate, a few indicators are useful:
segments.tr: 对于试图关注这场辩论的读者来说，有几个指标很有用：

segments.src: - **The size and structure of any funding request**, including whether it is labeled emergency spending.
segments.tr: - **任何资金请求的规模和结构**，包括它是否被贴上紧急支出的标签。

segments.src: - **Whether munitions funding includes multiyear contracts**, which signal a longer-term rebuilding effort rather than a one-time refill.
segments.tr: - **弹药资金是否包含多年期合同**，这标志着长期的重建努力，而非一次性的补充。

segments.src: - **Cost estimates from independent sources**, such as the Congressional Budget Office and nonpartisan think tanks, which often differ from administration figures.
segments.tr: - **来自独立来源的成本估计**，例如国会预算办公室和无党派智库，其数据往往与政府官方数字存在差异。

segments.src: - **Energy market movements**, which can indicate whether the economic side of the conflict is growing.
segments.tr: - **能源市场走势**，这可以表明冲突的经济波及面是否正在扩大。

segments.src: - **Statements on offsets**, which show how willing leaders are to pair new spending with cuts or revenue.
segments.tr: - **关于开支抵消的声明**，这表明领导人有多大意愿将新开支与削减其他开支或增加收入结合起来。

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 总结

segments.src: The cost of a conflict is more than the first number in a headline.
segments.tr: 冲突的成本远不止头条新闻中的第一个数字。

segments.src: It combines operating expenses, the long and expensive work of rebuilding stockpiles, and economic effects that reach well beyond the military.
segments.tr: 它结合了运行开支、重建库存的长远而昂贵的工作，以及远远超出军事领域的经济效应。

segments.src: How Congress responds will depend on how long events last, how lawmakers weigh security against borrowing, and whether the parties can agree on what to fund and how.
segments.tr: 国会如何回应将取决于事态发展持续多久、立法者如何在安全与借贷之间权衡，以及各党派能否就资助什么和如何资助达成一致。

segments.src: Whatever the outcome, the debate is likely to shape defense budgets and deficit discussions for years.
segments.tr: 无论结果如何，这场辩论都可能在未来几年重塑国防预算和赤字讨论。

segments.src: Readers who want to understand it should look past the headline total and ask what the money buys, who decides, and who ultimately pays.
segments.tr: 想要理解这一点的读者应该透过头条新闻的总额，去探究这笔钱买了什么、谁来决定以及最终由谁买单。

segments.src: ## The Three Big Cost Buckets

segments.src: That raises maintenance needs and can shorten the time before major repairs are due.
segments.tr: इससे रखरखाव की जरूरतें बढ़ जाती हैं और बड़ी मरम्मत की अवधि कम हो सकती है।

segments.src: Operating costs tend to grow with duration.
segments.tr: संचालन लागत अवधि के साथ बढ़ती जाती है।

segments.src: A short, limited operation may be absorbed within existing accounts.
segments.tr: एक छोटा, सीमित संचालन मौजूदा खातों के भीतर समायोजित किया जा सकता है।

segments.src: A prolonged presence usually is not.
segments.tr: एक लंबे समय तक उपस्थिति आमतौर पर ऐसा नहीं कर पाती।

segments.src: At that point the Pentagon often asks Congress for additional funds.
segments.tr: उस मोड़ पर पेंटागन अक्सर कांग्रेस से अतिरिक्त धनराशि की मांग करता है।

segments.src: ### 2. Munitions Replenishment
segments.tr: ### 2. गोला-बारूद की पुनःपूर्ति

segments.src: The second bucket is often the hardest to fix quickly.
segments.tr: दूसरी श्रेणी को अक्सर जल्दी ठीक करना सबसे कठिन होता है।

segments.src: Interceptors, precision-guided weapons and long-range missiles are expensive.
segments.tr: इंटरसेप्टर, सटीक-निर्देशित हथियार और लंबी दूरी की मिसाइलें महंगी होती हैं।

segments.src: They are also built by a small number of manufacturers on production lines that cannot simply be sped up.
segments.tr: वे उत्पादन लाइनों पर निर्माताओं की एक छोटी संख्या द्वारा निर्मित की जाती हैं जिन्हें आसानी से तेज नहीं किया जा सकता है।

segments.src: Defensive systems illustrate the problem.
segments.tr: रक्षात्मक प्रणालियां इस समस्या को दर्शाती हैं।

segments.src: An interceptor used to stop an incoming threat can cost far more than the threat itself.
segments.tr: आने वाले खतरे को रोकने के लिए उपयोग किया जाने वाला इंटरसेप्टर स्वयं खतरे की तुलना में कहीं अधिक महंगा हो सकता है।

segments.src: Even when the exchange succeeds, the stockpile shrinks.
segments.tr: भले ही कार्रवाई सफल हो जाए, फिर भी भंडार घट जाता है।

segments.src: Rebuilding it takes time, and the money has to be committed years ahead through multiyear contracts, factory expansion and supplier support.
segments.tr: इसे फिर से बनाने में समय लगता है, और धन को बहु-वर्षीय अनुबंधों, कारखाने के विस्तार और आपूर्तिकर्ता सहायता के माध्यम से वर्षों पहले प्रतिबद्ध करना पड़ता है।

segments.src: Analysts have repeatedly warned that U.S.
segments.tr: विश्लेषकों ने बार-बार चेतावनी दी है कि U.S.

segments.src: stockpiles of some key munitions are under strain from several demands at once.
segments.tr: के कुछ प्रमुख गोला-बारूद के स्टॉक एक साथ कई मांगों के कारण दबाव में हैं।

segments.src: Those demands include support for partners and the need to stay ready for other regions.
segments.tr: उन मांगों में भागीदारों के लिए सहायता और अन्य क्षेत्रों के लिए तैयार रहने की आवश्यकता शामिल है।

segments.src: A conflict that uses these weapons heavily could turn that strain into an urgent funding request.
segments.tr: इन हथियारों का भारी उपयोग करने वाला संघर्ष उस दबाव को एक तत्काल वित्तपोषण अनुरोध में बदल सकता है।

segments.src: ### 3. Energy and Economic Spillovers
segments.tr: ### 3. ऊर्जा और आर्थिक दुष्प्रभाव

segments.src: The third bucket is less visible in the defense budget but can matter just as much to households.
segments.tr: तीसरी श्रेणी रक्षा बजट में कम दिखाई देती है लेकिन परिवारों के लिए उतनी ही मायने रख सकती है।

segments.src: The Middle East is central to global oil and gas flows, and any threat to shipping lanes or production can raise energy prices.
segments.tr: मध्य पूर्व वैश्विक तेल और गैस प्रवाह का केंद्र है, और शिपिंग लेन या उत्पादन के लिए कोई भी खतरा ऊर्जा की कीमतों को बढ़ा सकता है।

segments.src: Higher fuel costs affect:
segments.tr: ईंधन की उच्च लागत प्रभावित करती है:

segments.src: - **The military itself**, which is one of the largest single energy consumers in the federal government.
segments.tr: - **स्वयं सेना को**, जो संघीय सरकार में सबसे बड़े ऊर्जा उपभोक्ताओं में से एक है।

segments.src: - **Consumers**, who may see the effect at the pump and in transportation and shipping costs.
segments.tr: - **उपभोक्ताओं को**, जो पंप पर और परिवहन व शिपिंग लागतों में प्रभाव देख सकते हैं।

segments.src: - **Inflation and interest rates**, which in turn influence the government's own borrowing costs.
segments.tr: - **मुद्रास्फीति और ब्याज दरों को**, जो बदले में सरकार की अपनी उधार लेने की लागत को प्रभावित करती हैं।

segments.src: These effects are difficult to forecast and can fade quickly or persist, depending on events.
segments.tr: इन प्रभावों का पूर्वानुमान लगाना कठिन है और घटनाओं के आधार पर ये जल्दी गायब हो सकते हैं या बने रह सकते हैं।

segments.src: They are still part of the real cost of a conflict, even though they never appear on a Pentagon spreadsheet.
segments.tr: वे अभी भी एक संघर्ष की वास्तविक लागत का हिस्सा हैं, भले ही वे पेंटागन की स्प्रेडशीट पर कभी दिखाई न दें।

segments.src: ## How Congress Pays for War
segments.tr: ## कांग्रेस युद्ध के लिए भुगतान कैसे करती है

segments.src: Congress has several ways to fund military action, and each has trade-offs.
segments.tr: सैन्य कार्रवाई को वित्तपोषित करने के लिए कांग्रेस के पास कई तरीके हैं, और प्रत्येक के अपने समझौते हैं।

segments.src: - **The regular defense appropriations bill.** This is the most transparent route, but it competes directly with every other priority under spending limits.
segments.tr: - **नियमित रक्षा विनियोग विधेयक।** यह सबसे पारदर्शी मार्ग है, लेकिन यह खर्च सीमा के तहत हर दूसरी प्राथमिकता के साथ सीधे प्रतिस्पर्धा करता है।

segments.src: - **Supplemental appropriations.** These are emergency requests passed outside the regular process. They can move quickly, but they are often debated as stand-alone packages and can attract unrelated demands.
segments.tr: - **पूरक विनियोग।** ये नियमित प्रक्रिया के बाहर पारित आपातकालीन अनुरोध हैं। वे तेजी से आगे बढ़ सकते हैं, लेकिन उन पर अक्सर स्वतंत्र पैकेजों के रूप में बहस की जाती है और वे असंबंधित मांगों को आकर्षित कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: - **Overseas contingency-style accounts.** In past conflicts, designating funds as emergency or war-related allowed spending to sit outside normal budget caps. Critics have argued that this approach can blur the line between true war costs and routine expenses.
segments.tr: - **विदेशी आकस्मिकता-शैली के खाते।** अतीत के संघर्षों में, निधियों को आपातकालीन या युद्ध-संबंधित के रूप में नामित करने से खर्च सामान्य बजट सीमा से बाहर रहने में सक्षम हुआ। आलोचकों ने तर्क दिया है कि यह दृष्टिकोण सच्चे युद्ध खर्चों और नियमित खर्चों के बीच की रेखा को धुंधला कर सकता है।

segments.src: Which route lawmakers choose has real consequences.
segments.tr: कानून निर्माता कौन सा मार्ग चुनते हैं, इसके वास्तविक परिणाम होते हैं।

segments.src: Emergency designations can ease pressure on other programs, but they also add to the deficit without an offset.
segments.tr: आपातकालीन पदनाम अन्य कार्यक्रमों पर दबाव कम कर सकते हैं, लेकिन वे बिना किसी भरपाई के घाटे को भी बढ़ाते हैं।

segments.src: Funding through the regular process forces trade-offs that some members would rather avoid.
segments.tr: नियमित प्रक्रिया के माध्यम से वित्तपोषण उन समझौतों को मजबूर करता है जिनसे कुछ सदस्य बचना चाहेंगे।

segments.src: ## The Deficit Collision
segments.tr: ## घाटे का टकराव

segments.src: War funding does not arrive in an empty room.
segments.tr: युद्ध वित्तपोषण किसी खाली कमरे में नहीं आता है।

segments.src: The federal government is running large annual deficits, and interest payments on the national debt have become one of the fastest-growing parts of the budget.
segments.tr: संघीय सरकार बड़े वार्षिक घाटे का सामना कर रही है, और राष्ट्रीय ऋण पर ब्याज भुगतान बजट के सबसे तेजी से बढ़ते हिस्सों में से एक बन गया है।

segments.src: In that setting, any new spending request raises a familiar question: should it be paid for, or added to the debt?
segments.tr: उस माहौल में, कोई भी नया खर्च अनुरोध एक परिचित प्रश्न उठाता है: क्या इसका भुगतान किया जाना चाहिए, या ऋण में जोड़ा जाना चाहिए?

segments.src: Deficit-minded lawmakers may argue that new defense spending should be offset with cuts or revenue elsewhere.
segments.tr: घाटे के प्रति सचेत कानून निर्माता तर्क दे सकते हैं कि नए रक्षा खर्च की भरपाई कहीं और कटौती या राजस्व से की जानी चाहिए।

segments.src: Defense advocates may reply that national security needs cannot wait for a budget deal, and that delay can cost more in the long run.
segments.tr: रक्षा समर्थक उत्तर दे सकते हैं कि राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षा की जरूरतें बजट समझौते का इंतजार नहीं कर सकतीं, और देरी से लंबे समय में अधिक लागत आ सकती है।

segments.src: Both arguments have a long history in Congress, and neither side wins automatically.
segments.tr: कांग्रेस में दोनों तर्कों का एक लंबा इतिहास रहा है, और कोई भी पक्ष स्वचालित रूप से नहीं जीतता है।

segments.src: The result is often a negotiation in which several groups hold leverage at once:
segments.tr: परिणाम अक्सर एक ऐसी बातचीत होती है जिसमें एक साथ कई समूहों के पास प्रभाव होता है:

segments.src: 1. **Defense hawks** who want faster and larger investments in munitions and readiness.
segments.tr: 1. **रक्षा नीति के पक्षधर (डिफेंस हॉक्स)** जो गोला-बारूद और तत्परता में तेजी से और बड़े निवेश चाहते हैं।

segments.src: 2. **Fiscal conservatives** who want offsets or lower overall spending.
segments.tr: 2. **वित्तीय रूढ़िवादी** जो कटौती या कुल मिलाकर कम खर्च चाहते हैं।

segments.src: 3. **Appropriators of both parties** who want to protect domestic programs, infrastructure and aid to their districts.
segments.tr: 3. **दोनों दलों के विनियोजक** जो घरेलू कार्यक्रमों, बुनियादी ढांचे और अपने जिलों को मिलने वाली सहायता की रक्षा करना चाहते हैं।

segments.src: 4. **Members skeptical of military involvement** who may use the budget as a way to question the mission itself.
segments.tr: 4. **सैन्य भागीदारी के प्रति संशयवादी सदस्य** जो मिशन पर ही सवाल उठाने के लिए बजट का उपयोग कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: ## Competing Priorities
segments.tr: ## प्रतिस्पर्धी प्राथमिकताएं

segments.src: A war supplemental rarely travels alone.
segments.tr: युद्ध का पूरक बजट (वॉर सप्लीमेंटल) शायद ही कभी अकेले आता है।

segments.src: Other items often compete for attention at the same time, including aid to allies, border and security funding, disaster relief, and domestic priorities that members want to attach to a must-pass bill.
segments.tr: अन्य वस्तुएं अक्सर एक ही समय में ध्यान आकर्षित करने के लिए प्रतिस्पर्धा करती हैं, जिनमें सहयोगियों को सहायता, सीमा और सुरक्षा वित्तपोषण, आपदा राहत और घरेलू प्राथमिकताएं शामिल हैं जिन्हें सदस्य एक अवश्य-पारित विधेयक से जोड़ना चाहते हैं।

segments.src: The more items in a package, the harder it is to build a majority, but the more reasons different members have to vote yes.
segments.tr: एक पैकेज में जितनी अधिक वस्तुएं होंगी, बहुमत बनाना उतना ही कठिन होगा, लेकिन विभिन्न सदस्यों के पास हां में वोट देने के उतने ही अधिक कारण होंगे।

segments.src: There are also longer-term defense questions.
segments.tr: दीर्घकालिक रक्षा प्रश्न भी हैं।

segments.src: Shipbuilding, aircraft modernization, missile defense and the industrial base all need sustained funding.
segments.tr: जहाज निर्माण, विमान आधुनिकीकरण, मिसाइल रक्षा और औद्योगिक आधार सभी को निरंतर वित्तपोषण की आवश्यकता होती है।

segments.src: If a conflict absorbs a large share of available money, some of those long-term programs could be delayed or scaled back.
segments.tr: यदि कोई संघर्ष उपलब्ध धन का एक बड़ा हिस्सा अवशोषित कर लेता है, तो उन दीर्घकालिक कार्यक्रमों में से कुछ में देरी हो सकती है या उन्हें कम किया जा सकता है।

segments.src: If instead Congress treats the conflict as a reason to spend more overall, the deficit pressure grows.
segments.tr: यदि इसके बजाय कांग्रेस संघर्ष को कुल मिलाकर अधिक खर्च करने के कारण के रूप में देखती है, तो घाटे का दबाव बढ़ जाता है।

segments.src: ## What to Watch
segments.tr: ## किन बातों पर ध्यान दें

segments.src: For readers trying to follow the debate, a few indicators are useful:
segments.tr: बहस का अनुसरण करने का प्रयास कर रहे पाठकों के लिए, कुछ संकेतक उपयोगी हैं:

segments.src: - **The size and structure of any funding request**, including whether it is labeled emergency spending.
segments.tr: - **किसी भी वित्तपोषण अनुरोध का आकार और संरचना**, जिसमें यह शामिल है कि क्या इसे आपातकालीन खर्च के रूप में लेबल किया गया है।

segments.src: - **Whether munitions funding includes multiyear contracts**, which signal a longer-term rebuilding effort rather than a one-time refill.
segments.tr: - **क्या गोला-बारूद वित्तपोषण में बहु-वर्षीय अनुबंध शामिल हैं**, जो एक बार के पुनर्भरण के बजाय दीर्घकालिक पुनर्निर्माण प्रयास का संकेत देते हैं।

segments.src: - **Cost estimates from independent sources**, such as the Congressional Budget Office and nonpartisan think tanks, which often differ from administration figures.
segments.tr: - **स्वतंत्र स्रोतों से लागत अनुमान**, जैसे कि कांग्रेस के बजट कार्यालय और गैर-पक्षपाती थिंक टैंक, जो अक्सर प्रशासन के आंकड़ों से भिन्न होते हैं।

segments.src: - **Energy market movements**, which can indicate whether the economic side of the conflict is growing.
segments.tr: - **ऊर्जा बाजार की हलचल**, जो यह संकेत दे सकती है कि संघर्ष का आर्थिक पक्ष बढ़ रहा है या नहीं।

segments.src: - **Statements on offsets**, which show how willing leaders are to pair new spending with cuts or revenue.
segments.tr: - **भरपाई पर बयान**, जो दिखाते हैं कि नेता नए खर्च को कटौती या राजस्व के साथ जोड़ने के लिए कितने इच्छुक हैं।

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## मुख्य बात

segments.src: The cost of a conflict is more than the first number in a headline.
segments.tr: किसी संघर्ष की लागत मुख्य समाचार (हेडलाइन) की पहली संख्या से कहीं अधिक होती है।

segments.src: It combines operating expenses, the long and expensive work of rebuilding stockpiles, and economic effects that reach well beyond the military.
segments.tr: यह परिचालन खर्चों, भंडारों के पुनर्निर्माण के लंबे और महंगे काम, और आर्थिक प्रभावों को जोड़ती है जो सेना से कहीं आगे तक पहुंचते हैं।

segments.src: How Congress responds will depend on how long events last, how lawmakers weigh security against borrowing, and whether the parties can agree on what to fund and how.
segments.tr: कांग्रेस कैसे प्रतिक्रिया देती है यह इस बात पर निर्भर करेगा कि घटनाएं कब तक चलती हैं, विधायक ऋण के मुकाबले सुरक्षा को कैसे तौलते हैं, और क्या दल इस बात पर सहमत हो सकते हैं कि किसे और कैसे वित्तपोषित किया जाए।

segments.src: Whatever the outcome, the debate is likely to shape defense budgets and deficit discussions for years.
segments.tr: परिणाम चाहे जो भी हो, इस बहस द्वारा आने वाले वर्षों के लिए रक्षा बजट और घाटे की चर्चाओं को आकार देने की संभावना है।

segments.src: ## Why the Bill Matters
segments.tr: ## Por qué es importante la factura

segments.src: Every military operation comes with a price tag, and the final total is rarely the number first discussed.
segments.tr: Toda operación militar tiene un precio, y el total final rara vez es la cifra de la que se habla al principio.

segments.src: Flying aircraft, keeping ships at sea, moving troops and running air defenses all cost money.
segments.tr: Hacer volar aviones, mantener barcos en el mar, desplazar tropas y operar defensas aéreas cuesta dinero.

segments.src: So does replacing the weapons that get used.
segments.tr: También lo cuesta reemplazar el armamento que se utiliza.

segments.src: When a conflict involving Iran draws in U.S.
segments.tr: Cuando un conflicto en el que participa Irán involucra a las fuerzas de U.S.

segments.src: forces or U.S.

segments.src: partners, those costs move from military planning documents into a budget debate in Washington.
segments.tr: esos costos pasan de los documentos de planificación militar a un debate presupuestario en Washington.

segments.src: This article does not try to predict how any conflict will unfold.
segments.tr: Este artículo no intenta predecir cómo se desarrollará ningún conflicto.

segments.src: It looks at the main categories of cost, how Congress usually pays for them, and why the timing is hard.
segments.tr: Examina las principales categorías de costos, cómo suele pagarlos el Congreso y por qué el momento es complicado.

segments.src: Federal borrowing is already high, and lawmakers are already divided over what to prioritize.
segments.tr: El endeudamiento federal ya es elevado, y los legisladores ya están divididos sobre a qué priorizar.

segments.src: ## The Three Big Cost Buckets
segments.tr: ## Los tres grandes bloques de costos

segments.src: ### 1. Operations
segments.tr: ### 1. Operaciones

segments.src: Operating costs are the day-to-day expenses of a deployment.
segments.tr: Los costos operativos son los gastos diarios de un despliegue.

segments.src: They include fuel, maintenance, flight hours, personnel pay and allowances, logistics and intelligence support.
segments.tr: Incluyen combustible, mantenimiento, horas de vuelo, sueldos y asignaciones del personal, logística y apoyo de inteligencia.

segments.src: Ships and aircraft that stay deployed longer than planned wear out faster.
segments.tr: Los buques y aeronaves que permanecen desplegados más tiempo de lo previsto se desgastan más rápido.

segments.src: That raises maintenance needs and can shorten the time before major repairs are due.
segments.tr: Eso aumenta las necesidades de mantenimiento y puede acortar el tiempo hasta que se requieran reparaciones mayores.

segments.src: Operating costs tend to grow with duration.
segments.tr: Los costos operativos tienden a crecer con la duración.

segments.src: A short, limited operation may be absorbed within existing accounts.
segments.tr: Una operación corta y limitada puede ser absorbida dentro de las cuentas existentes.

segments.src: A prolonged presence usually is not.
segments.tr: Una presencia prolongada por lo general no.

segments.src: At that point the Pentagon often asks Congress for additional funds.
segments.tr: En ese momento, el Pentágono suele pedir fondos adicionales al Congreso.

segments.src: ### 2. Munitions Replenishment
segments.tr: ### 2. Reposición de municiones

segments.src: The second bucket is often the hardest to fix quickly.
segments.tr: El segundo bloque suele ser el más difícil de solucionar con rapidez.

segments.src: Interceptors, precision-guided weapons and long-range missiles are expensive.
segments.tr: Los interceptores, las armas guiadas de precisión y los misiles de largo alcance son caros.

segments.src: They are also built by a small number of manufacturers on production lines that cannot simply be sped up.
segments.tr: Además, son fabricados por un número reducido de empresas en líneas de producción que no se pueden acelerar simplemente.

segments.src: Defensive systems illustrate the problem.
segments.tr: Los sistemas defensivos ilustran el problema.

segments.src: An interceptor used to stop an incoming threat can cost far more than the threat itself.
segments.tr: Un interceptor utilizado para detener una amenaza entrante puede costar mucho más que la amenaza misma.

segments.src: Even when the exchange succeeds, the stockpile shrinks.
segments.tr: Incluso cuando el intercambio es exitoso, las reservas disminuyen.

segments.src: Rebuilding it takes time, and the money has to be committed years ahead through multiyear contracts, factory expansion and supplier support.
segments.tr: Reconstruirlas lleva tiempo, y el dinero debe comprometerse con años de antelación a través de contratos plurianuales, expansión de fábricas y apoyo a proveedores.

segments.src: Analysts have repeatedly warned that U.S.
segments.tr: Los analistas han advertido repetidamente que las reservas de U.S.

segments.src: stockpiles of some key munitions are under strain from several demands at once.
segments.tr: de algunas municiones clave están bajo presión debido a varias demandas simultáneas.

segments.src: Those demands include support for partners and the need to stay ready for other regions.
segments.tr: Esas demandas incluyen el apoyo a los socios y la necesidad de mantenerse preparados para otras regiones.

segments.src: A conflict that uses these weapons heavily could turn that strain into an urgent funding request.
segments.tr: Un conflicto que utilice intensamente estas armas podría convertir esa presión en una solicitud urgente de financiación.

segments.src: ### 3. Energy and Economic Spillovers
segments.tr: ### 3. Repercusiones económicas y energéticas

segments.src: The third bucket is less visible in the defense budget but can matter just as much to households.
segments.tr: El tercer bloque es menos visible en el presupuesto de defensa, pero puede importar del mismo modo a los hogares.

segments.src: The Middle East is central to global oil and gas flows, and any threat to shipping lanes or production can raise energy prices.
segments.tr: El Medio Oriente es fundamental para los flujos mundiales de petróleo y gas, y cualquier amenaza a las rutas de navegación o a la producción puede hacer subir los precios de la energía.

segments.src: Higher fuel costs affect:
segments.tr: Los mayores costos del combustible afectan a:

segments.src: - **The military itself**, which is one of the largest single energy consumers in the federal government.
segments.tr: - **Las propias fuerzas armadas**, que son uno de los mayores consumidores individuales de energía dentro del gobierno federal.

segments.src: - **Consumers**, who may see the effect at the pump and in transportation and shipping costs.
segments.tr: - **Los consumidores**, que pueden notar el efecto en las gasolineras y en los costos de transporte y envío.

segments.src: - **Inflation and interest rates**, which in turn influence the government's own borrowing costs.
segments.tr: - **La inflación y los tipos de interés**, que a su vez influyen en los propios costos de endeudamiento del gobierno.

segments.src: These effects are difficult to forecast and can fade quickly or persist, depending on events.
segments.tr: Estos efectos son difíciles de prever y pueden desaparecer rápidamente o persistir, según los acontecimientos.

segments.src: They are still part of the real cost of a conflict, even though they never appear on a Pentagon spreadsheet.
segments.tr: Siguen siendo parte del costo real de un conflicto, aunque nunca aparezcan en una hoja de cálculo del Pentágono.

segments.src: ## How Congress Pays for War
segments.tr: ## Cómo paga el Congreso la guerra

segments.src: Congress has several ways to fund military action, and each has trade-offs.
segments.tr: El Congreso dispone de varias vías para financiar la acción militar, y cada una implica concesiones.

segments.src: - **The regular defense appropriations bill.** This is the most transparent route, but it competes directly with every other priority under spending limits.
segments.tr: - **El proyecto de ley ordinario de asignaciones para la defensa.** Es la vía más transparente, pero compite directamente con todas las demás prioridades bajo los límites de gasto.

segments.src: - **Supplemental appropriations.** These are emergency requests passed outside the regular process. They can move quickly, but they are often debated as stand-alone packages and can attract unrelated demands.
segments.tr: - **Asignaciones suplementarias.** Son solicitudes de emergencia aprobadas fuera del proceso ordinario. Pueden tramitarse rápidamente, pero a menudo se debaten como paquetes independientes y pueden atraer demandas no relacionadas.

segments.src: - **Overseas contingency-style accounts.** In past conflicts, designating funds as emergency or war-related allowed spending to sit outside normal budget caps. Critics have argued that this approach can blur the line between true war costs and routine expenses.
segments.tr: - **Cuentas de tipo contingencia en el extranjero.** En conflictos pasados, clasificar los fondos como de emergencia o vinculados a la guerra permitía que el gasto quedara fuera de los límites presupuestarios habituales. Los críticos han argumentado que este enfoque puede desdibujar la línea entre los costos reales de la guerra y los gastos rutinarios.

segments.src: Which route lawmakers choose has real consequences.
segments.tr: La vía que elijan los legisladores tiene consecuencias reales.

segments.src: Emergency designations can ease pressure on other programs, but they also add to the deficit without an offset.
segments.tr: Las designaciones de emergencia pueden aliviar la presión sobre otros programas, pero también aumentan el déficit sin compensación.

segments.src: Funding through the regular process forces trade-offs that some members would rather avoid.
segments.tr: La financiación a través del proceso ordinario fuerza compensaciones que algunos miembros preferirían evitar.

segments.src: ## The Deficit Collision
segments.tr: ## La colisión con el déficit

segments.src: War funding does not arrive in an empty room.
segments.tr: La financiación de la guerra no llega a una sala vacía.

segments.src: The federal government is running large annual deficits, and interest payments on the national debt have become one of the fastest-growing parts of the budget.
segments.tr: El gobierno federal registra grandes déficits anuales, y los pagos de intereses de la deuda nacional se han convertido en una de las partes de más rápido crecimiento del presupuesto.

segments.src: In that setting, any new spending request raises a familiar question: should it be paid for, or added to the debt?
segments.tr: En ese contexto, cualquier nueva solicitud de gasto plantea una pregunta familiar: ¿debe pagarse o añadirse a la deuda?

segments.src: Deficit-minded lawmakers may argue that new defense spending should be offset with cuts or revenue elsewhere.
segments.tr: Los legisladores preocupados por el déficit pueden argumentar que el nuevo gasto en defensa debería compensarse con recortes o ingresos en otras partes.

segments.src: Defense advocates may reply that national security needs cannot wait for a budget deal, and that delay can cost more in the long run.
segments.tr: Los defensores de la defensa pueden responder que las necesidades de seguridad nacional no pueden esperar a un acuerdo presupuestario, y que la demora puede costar más a largo plazo.

segments.src: Both arguments have a long history in Congress, and neither side wins automatically.
segments.tr: Ambos argumentos tienen un largo historial en el Congreso, y ninguna de las partes gana automáticamente.

segments.src: The result is often a negotiation in which several groups hold leverage at once:
segments.tr: El resultado suele ser una negociación en la que varios grupos mantienen influencia al mismo tiempo:

segments.src: 1. **Defense hawks** who want faster and larger investments in munitions and readiness.
segments.tr: 1. **Los 'halcones' de la defensa** que desean inversiones más rápidas y mayores en municiones y preparación.

segments.src: 2. **Fiscal conservatives** who want offsets or lower overall spending.
segments.tr: 2. **Los conservadores fiscales** que quieren compensaciones o un gasto general más bajo.

segments.src: 3. **Appropriators of both parties** who want to protect domestic programs, infrastructure and aid to their districts.
segments.tr: 3. **Los miembros del comité de asignaciones de ambos partidos** que buscan proteger programas domésticos, infraestructura y ayudas para sus distritos.

segments.src: 4. **Members skeptical of military involvement** who may use the budget as a way to question the mission itself.
segments.tr: 4. **Los miembros escépticos de la intervención militar** que pueden utilizar el presupuesto como vía para cuestionar la misión misma.

segments.src: ## Competing Priorities
segments.tr: ## Prioridades en competencia

segments.src: A war supplemental rarely travels alone.
segments.tr: Un suplemento de guerra rara vez viaja solo.

segments.src: Other items often compete for attention at the same time, including aid to allies, border and security funding, disaster relief, and domestic priorities that members want to attach to a must-pass bill.
segments.tr: Otros asuntos a menudo compiten por la atención al mismo tiempo, incluyendo la ayuda a aliados, la financiación de fronteras y seguridad, la ayuda en desastres y las prioridades nacionales que los miembros quieren adjuntar a un proyecto de ley de aprobación obligatoria.

segments.src: The more items in a package, the harder it is to build a majority, but the more reasons different members have to vote yes.
segments.tr: Cuantos más elementos contenga un paquete, más difícil es construir una mayoría, pero más razones tienen los diferentes miembros para votar a favor.

segments.src: There are also longer-term defense questions.
segments.tr: También hay cuestiones de defensa a más largo plazo.

segments.src: Shipbuilding, aircraft modernization, missile defense and the industrial base all need sustained funding.
segments.tr: La construcción naval, la modernización de aeronaves, la defensa antimisiles y la base industrial necesitan financiación sostenida.

segments.src: If a conflict absorbs a large share of available money, some of those long-term programs could be delayed or scaled back.
segments.tr: Si un conflicto absorbe una gran parte del dinero disponible, algunos de esos programas a largo plazo podrían retrasarse o reducirse.

segments.src: If instead Congress treats the conflict as a reason to spend more overall, the deficit pressure grows.
segments.tr: Si, en cambio, el Congreso considera el conflicto como una razón para gastar más en general, la presión sobre el déficit aumenta.

segments.src: ## What to Watch
segments.tr: ## Qué observar

segments.src: For readers trying to follow the debate, a few indicators are useful:
segments.tr: Para los lectores que intenten seguir el debate, algunos indicadores resultan útiles:

segments.src: - **The size and structure of any funding request**, including whether it is labeled emergency spending.
segments.tr: - **El tamaño y la estructura de cualquier solicitud de fondos**, incluyendo si se etiqueta como gasto de emergencia.

segments.src: - **Whether munitions funding includes multiyear contracts**, which signal a longer-term rebuilding effort rather than a one-time refill.
segments.tr: - **Si la financiación de municiones incluye contratos plurianuales**, lo que indica un esfuerzo de reconstrucción a más largo plazo en lugar de un reabastecimiento puntual.

segments.src: - **Cost estimates from independent sources**, such as the Congressional Budget Office and nonpartisan think tanks, which often differ from administration figures.
segments.tr: - **Las estimaciones de costos de fuentes independientes**, como la Oficina de Presupuesto del Congreso y centros de estudio no partidistas, que a menudo difieren de las cifras de la administración.

segments.src: - **Energy market movements**, which can indicate whether the economic side of the conflict is growing.
segments.tr: - **Los movimientos de los mercados energéticos**, que pueden indicar si la dimensión económica del conflicto está aumentando.

segments.src: - **Statements on offsets**, which show how willing leaders are to pair new spending with cuts or revenue.
segments.tr: - **Las declaraciones sobre compensaciones**, que muestran hasta qué punto los líderes están dispuestos a acompañar el nuevo gasto con recortes o ingresos.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## En conclusión

segments.src: The cost of a conflict is more than the first number in a headline.
segments.tr: El costo de un conflicto es más que la primera cifra de un titular.

segments.src: It combines operating expenses, the long and expensive work of rebuilding stockpiles, and economic effects that reach well beyond the military.
segments.tr: Combina los gastos operativos, la larga y costosa labor de reconstruir las reservas y los efectos económicos que se extienden mucho más allá de lo militar.

segments.src: How Congress responds will depend on how long events last, how lawmakers weigh security against borrowing, and whether the parties can agree on what to fund and how.
segments.tr: La manera en que responda el Congreso dependerá de cuánto duren los acontecimientos, de cómo sopesen los legisladores la seguridad frente al endeudamiento y de si los partidos pueden ponerse de acuerdo sobre qué financiar y cómo.

segments.src: Whatever the outcome, the debate is likely to shape defense budgets and deficit discussions for years.
segments.tr: Cualquiera que sea el resultado, es probable que el debate defina los presupuestos de defensa y las discusiones sobre el déficit durante años.

segments.src: Readers who want to understand it should look past the headline total and ask what the money buys, who decides, and who ultimately pays.
segments.tr: Los lectores que quieran entenderlo deben mirar más allá del total del titular y preguntarse qué compra el dinero, quién decide y quién paga en última instancia.

segments.src: A conflict that uses these weapons heavily could turn that strain into an urgent funding request.
segments.tr: الصراع الذي يستخدم هذه الأسلحة بغزارة يمكن أن يحول هذا الضغط إلى طلب تمويل عاجل.

segments.src: ### 3. Energy and Economic Spillovers
segments.tr: ### 3. التداعيات الاقتصادية والطاقة

segments.src: The third bucket is less visible in the defense budget but can matter just as much to households.
segments.tr: الدلو الثالث أقل وضوحاً في ميزانية الدفاع ولكنه يمكن أن يكون بنفس الأهمية للأسر.

segments.src: The Middle East is central to global oil and gas flows, and any threat to shipping lanes or production can raise energy prices.
segments.tr: الشرق الأوسط مركزي لتدفقات النفط والغاز العالمية، وأي تهديد لممرات الشحن أو الإنتاج يمكن أن يرفع أسعار الطاقة.

segments.src: Higher fuel costs affect:
segments.tr: تكاليف الوقود الأعلى تؤثر على:

segments.src: - **The military itself**, which is one of the largest single energy consumers in the federal government.
segments.tr: - **الجيش نفسه**، وهو أحد أكبر مستهلكي الطاقة الفرديين في الحكومة الفيدرالية.

segments.src: - **Consumers**, who may see the effect at the pump and in transportation and shipping costs.
segments.tr: - **المستهلكين**، الذين قد يرون التأثير في محطات الوقود وفي تكاليف النقل والشحن.

segments.src: - **Inflation and interest rates**, which in turn influence the government's own borrowing costs.
segments.tr: - **التضخم وأسعار الفائدة**، والتي تؤثر بدورها على تكاليف اقتراض الحكومة نفسها.

segments.src: These effects are difficult to forecast and can fade quickly or persist, depending on events.
segments.tr: هذه الآثار يصعب التنبؤ بها ويمكن أن تتلاشى بسرعة أو تستمر، اعتماداً على الأحداث.

segments.src: They are still part of the real cost of a conflict, even though they never appear on a Pentagon spreadsheet.
segments.tr: فهي لا تزال جزءاً من التكلفة الحقيقية للصراع، على الرغم من أنها لا تظهر أبداً على جدول بيانات البنتاغون.

segments.src: ## How Congress Pays for War
segments.tr: ## كيف يمول الكونغرس الحرب

segments.src: Congress has several ways to fund military action, and each has trade-offs.
segments.tr: لدى الكونغرس عدة طرق لتمويل العمل العسكري، وكل منها لها مقايضات.

segments.src: - **The regular defense appropriations bill.** This is the most transparent route, but it competes directly with every other priority under spending limits.
segments.tr: - **مشروع قانون اعتمادات الدفاع المنتظم.** هذا هو المسار الأكثر شفافية، ولكنه يتنافس مباشرة مع كل أولوية أخرى في حدود الإنفاق.

segments.src: - **Supplemental appropriations.** These are emergency requests passed outside the regular process. They can move quickly, but they are often debated as stand-alone packages and can attract unrelated demands.
segments.tr: - **الاعتمادات التكميلية.** هذه طلبات طارئة يتم تمريرها خارج العملية العادية. يمكن أن تتحرك بسرعة، لكن غالباً ما تتم مناقشتها كحزم قائمة بذاتها ويمكن أن تجذب مطالب غير ذات صلة.

segments.src: - **Overseas contingency-style accounts.** In past conflicts, designating funds as emergency or war-related allowed spending to sit outside normal budget caps. Critics have argued that this approach can blur the line between true war costs and routine expenses.
segments.tr: - **الحسابات على غرار الطوارئ في الخارج.** في الصراعات السابقة، سمح تخصيص الأموال كطوارئ أو مرتبطة بالحرب بأن يكون الإنفاق خارج حدود الميزانية العادية. جادل النقاد بأن هذا النهج يمكن أن يطمس الخط الفاصل بين تكاليف الحرب الحقيقية والنفقات الروتينية.

segments.src: Which route lawmakers choose has real consequences.
segments.tr: أي مسار يختاره المشرعون له عواقب حقيقية.

segments.src: Emergency designations can ease pressure on other programs, but they also add to the deficit without an offset.
segments.tr: تصنيفات الطوارئ يمكن أن تخفف الضغط على البرامج الأخرى، لكنها تضيف أيضاً إلى العجز دون تعويض.

segments.src: Funding through the regular process forces trade-offs that some members would rather avoid.
segments.tr: التمويل من خلال العملية العادية يفرض مقايضات يفضل بعض الأعضاء تجنبها.

segments.src: ## The Deficit Collision
segments.tr: ## اصطدام العجز

segments.src: War funding does not arrive in an empty room.
segments.tr: تمويل الحرب لا يصل في غرفة فارغة.

segments.src: The federal government is running large annual deficits, and interest payments on the national debt have become one of the fastest-growing parts of the budget.
segments.tr: تسجل الحكومة الفيدرالية عجزاً سنوياً كبيراً، وأصبحت مدفوعات الفائدة على الدين الوطني واحدة من أسرع أجزاء الميزانية نمواً.

segments.src: In that setting, any new spending request raises a familiar question: should it be paid for, or added to the debt?
segments.tr: في هذا الإطار، يثير أي طلب تمويل جديد سؤالاً مألوفاً: هل ينبغي دفع ثمنه، أم إضافته إلى الدين؟

segments.src: Deficit-minded lawmakers may argue that new defense spending should be offset with cuts or revenue elsewhere.
segments.tr: قد يجادل المشرعون المهتمون بالعجز بأن الإنفاق الدفاعي الجديد يجب تعويضه بتخفيضات أو إيرادات في مكان آخر.

segments.src: Defense advocates may reply that national security needs cannot wait for a budget deal, and that delay can cost more in the long run.
segments.tr: قد يرد مدافعو الدفاع بأن احتياجات الأمن القومي لا يمكنها انتظار صفقة ميزانية، وأن التأخير يمكن أن يكلف أكثر على المدى الطويل.

segments.src: Both arguments have a long history in Congress, and neither side wins automatically.
segments.tr: كلا الحجتين لهما تاريخ طويل في الكونغرس، ولا يفوز أي جانب تلقائياً.

segments.src: The result is often a negotiation in which several groups hold leverage at once:
segments.tr: النتيجة غالباً ما تكون مفاوضات تحتفظ فيها عدة مجموعات بنفوذ في نفس الوقت:

segments.src: 1. **Defense hawks** who want faster and larger investments in munitions and readiness.
segments.tr: 1. **صقور الدفاع** الذين يريدون استثماراتا أسرع وأكبر في الذخائر والجاهزية.

segments.src: 2. **Fiscal conservatives** who want offsets or lower overall spending.
segments.tr: 2. **المحافظون الماليون** الذين يريدون تعويضات أو خفض الإنفاق الإجمالي.

segments.src: 3. **Appropriators of both parties** who want to protect domestic programs, infrastructure and aid to their districts.
segments.tr: 3. **المعتمدون من كلا الحزبين** الذين يريدون حماية البرامج المحلية والبنية التحتية والمساعدات لمناطقهم.

segments.src: 4. **Members skeptical of military involvement** who may use the budget as a way to question the mission itself.
segments.tr: 4. **الأعضاء المتشككون في التدخل العسكري** الذين قد يستخدمون الميزانية كطريقة للتشكيك في المهمة نفسها.

segments.src: ## Competing Priorities
segments.tr: ## الأولويات المتنافسة

segments.src: A war supplemental rarely travels alone.
segments.tr: نادراً ما يسافر تكميلي الحرب بمفرده.

segments.src: Other items often compete for attention at the same time, including aid to allies, border and security funding, disaster relief, and domestic priorities that members want to attach to a must-pass bill.
segments.tr: غالباً ما تتنافس عناصر أخرى على الاهتمام في نفس الوقت، بما في ذلك المساعدات للحلفاء، وتمويل الحدود والأمن، والإغاثة من الكوارث، والأولويات المحلية التي يريد الأعضاء إرفاقها بمشروع قانون يجب تمريره.

segments.src: The more items in a package, the harder it is to build a majority, but the more reasons different members have to vote yes.
segments.tr: كلما زادت العناصر في الحزمة، كلما كان بناء الأغلبية أصعب، ولكن كلما زادت أسباب تصويت الأعضاء المختلفين بنعم.

segments.src: There are also longer-term defense questions.
segments.tr: هناك أيضاً أسئلة دفاعية أطول مدى.

segments.src: Shipbuilding, aircraft modernization, missile defense and the industrial base all need sustained funding.
segments.tr: بناء السفن، وتحديث الطائرات، والدفاع الصاروخي، والฐาน الصناعية كلها تحتاج إلى تمويل مستدام.

segments.src: If a conflict absorbs a large share of available money, some of those long-term programs could be delayed or scaled back.
segments.tr: إذا امتص صراع حصة كبيرة من الأموال المتاحة، فقد يتم تأخير أو تقليص بعض تلك البرامج طويلة الأجل.

segments.src: If instead Congress treats the conflict as a reason to spend more overall, the deficit pressure grows.
segments.tr: إذا اعتبر الكونغرس بدلاً من ذلك الصراع سبباً لإنفاق المزيد بشكل إجمالي، يزداد ضغط العجز.

segments.src: ## What to Watch
segments.tr: ## ما يجب مراقبته

segments.src: For readers trying to follow the debate, a few indicators are useful:
segments.tr: بالنسبة للقراء الذين يحاولون متابعة النقاش، هناك مؤشرات قليلة مفيدة:

segments.src: - **The size and structure of any funding request**, including whether it is labeled emergency spending.
segments.tr: - **حجم وهيكل أي طلب تمويل**، بما في ذلك ما إذا كان مصنفاً كإنفاق طوارئ.

segments.src: - **Whether munitions funding includes multiyear contracts**, which signal a longer-term rebuilding effort rather than a one-time refill.
segments.tr: - **ما إذا كان تمويل الذخائر يتضمن عقوداً متعددة السنوات**، والتي تشير إلى جهود إعادة بناء طويلة الأجل بدلاً من إعادة تعبئة لمرة واحدة.

segments.src: - **Cost estimates from independent sources**, such as the Congressional Budget Office and nonpartisan think tanks, which often differ from administration figures.
segments.tr: - **تقديرات التكلفة من مصادر مستقلة**، مثل مكتب ميزانية الكونغرس ومراكز الفكر غير الحزبية، والتي غالباً ما تختلف عن أرقام الإدارة.

segments.src: - **Energy market movements**, which can indicate whether the economic side of the conflict is growing.
segments.tr: - **تحركات سوق الطاقة**، والتي يمكن أن تشير إلى ما إذا كان الجانب الاقتصادي للصراع ينمو.

segments.src: - **Statements on offsets**, which show how willing leaders are to pair new spending with cuts or revenue.
segments.tr: - **التصريحات بشأن التعويضات**، والتي تظهر مدى استعداد القادة لقرن الإنفاق الجديد بالتخفيضات أو الإيرادات.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## الخلاصة

segments.src: The cost of a conflict is more than the first number in a headline.
segments.tr: تكلفة الصراع هي أكثر من مجرد الرقم الأول في العنوان الرئيسي.

segments.src: It combines operating expenses, the long and expensive work of rebuilding stockpiles, and economic effects that reach well beyond the military.
segments.tr: فهي تجمع بين نفقات التشغيل، والعمل الطويل والمكلف لإعادة بناء المخزونات، والآثار الاقتصادية التي تمتد إلى ما هو أبعد بكثير من الجيش.

segments.src: How Congress responds will depend on how long events last, how lawmakers weigh security against borrowing, and whether the parties can agree on what to fund and how.
segments.tr: كيف يستجيب الكونغرس سيعتمد على المدة التي تستغرقها الأحداث، وكيف يوزن المشرعون الأمن مقابل الاقتراض، وما إذا كان بإمكان الأطراف الاتفاق على ما يجب تمويله وكيف.

segments.src: Whatever the outcome, the debate is likely to shape defense budgets and deficit discussions for years.
segments.tr: مهما كانت النتيجة، فمن المرجح أن يشكل النقاش ميزانيات الدفاع ومناقشات العجز لسنوات.

segments.src: Readers who want to understand it should look past the headline total and ask what the money buys, who decides, and who ultimately pays.
segments.tr: القراء الذين يريدون فهمه يجب أن ينظروا إلى ما بعد إجمالي العنوان الرئيسي ويسألوا عما يشتريه المال، ومن يقرر، ومن يدفع في النهاية.

segments.tr: *هذه المقالة لأغراض معلوماتية عامة فقط وليست نصيحة مالية أو استثمارية أو سياسية.

segments.src: Figures and events can change quickly, so readers should consult official government sources and reputable news outlets for the latest information.*
segments.tr: الأرقام والأحداث يمكن أن تتغير بسرعة، لذا يجب على القراء استشارة مصادر الحكومة الرسمية ومنافذ الأخبار ذات السمعة الطيبة للحصول على أحدث المعلومات.*

segments.src: ## The Three Big Cost Buckets
segments.tr: ## Les trois grands pôles de coûts

segments.src: ### 1. Operations
segments.tr: ### 1. Les opérations

segments.src: Operating costs are the day-to-day expenses of a deployment.
segments.tr: Les coûts opérationnels sont les dépenses quotidiennes d'un déploiement.

segments.src: They include fuel, maintenance, flight hours, personnel pay and allowances, logistics and intelligence support.
segments.tr: Ils comprennent le carburant, la maintenance, les heures de vol, la solde et les indemnités du personnel, ainsi que le soutien logistique et du renseignement.

segments.src: Ships and aircraft that stay deployed longer than planned wear out faster.
segments.tr: Les navires et les aéronefs qui restent déployés plus longtemps que prévu s'usent plus rapidement.

segments.src: That raises maintenance needs and can shorten the time before major repairs are due.
segments.tr: Cela augmente les besoins en maintenance et peut réduire le délai avant des réparations majeures.

segments.src: Operating costs tend to grow with duration.
segments.tr: Les coûts opérationnels ont tendance à augmenter avec la durée.

segments.src: A short, limited operation may be absorbed within existing accounts.
segments.tr: Une opération courte et limitée peut être absorbée par les comptes existants.

segments.src: A prolonged presence usually is not.
segments.tr: Une présence prolongée ne l'est généralement pas.

segments.src: At that point the Pentagon often asks Congress for additional funds.
segments.tr: À ce stade, le Pentagone demande souvent des fonds supplémentaires au Congrès.

segments.src: ### 2. Munitions Replenishment
segments.tr: ### 2. Le réapprovisionnement en munitions

segments.src: The second bucket is often the hardest to fix quickly.
segments.tr: Le deuxième pôle est souvent le plus difficile à résoudre rapidement.

segments.src: Interceptors, precision-guided weapons and long-range missiles are expensive.
segments.tr: Les intercepteurs, les armes à guidage de précision et les missiles à longue portée coûtent cher.

segments.src: They are also built by a small number of manufacturers on production lines that cannot simply be sped up.
segments.tr: Ils sont également construits par un petit nombre de fabricants sur des lignes de production qu'il n'est pas possible d'accélérer simplement.

segments.src: Defensive systems illustrate the problem.
segments.tr: Les systèmes défensifs illustrent le problème.

segments.src: An interceptor used to stop an incoming threat can cost far more than the threat itself.
segments.tr: Un intercepteur utilisé pour neutraliser une menace imminente peut coûter bien plus cher que la menace elle-même.

segments.src: Even when the exchange succeeds, the stockpile shrinks.
segments.tr: Même lorsque l'échange réussit, le stock diminue.

segments.src: Rebuilding it takes time, and the money has to be committed years ahead through multiyear contracts, factory expansion and supplier support.
segments.tr: Le reconstituer prend du temps, et l'argent doit être engagé des années à l'avance par le biais de contrats pluriannuels, d'expansion d'usines et de soutien aux fournisseurs.

segments.tr: États-Unis sont sous pression en raison de plusieurs demandes simultanées.

segments.src: Those demands include support for partners and the need to stay ready for other regions.
segments.tr: Ces demandes incluent le soutien aux partenaires et la nécessité de rester prêt pour d'autres régions.

segments.src: A conflict that uses these weapons heavily could turn that strain into an urgent funding request.
segments.tr: Un conflit faisant grand usage de ces armes pourrait transformer cette tension en une demande de financement urgente.

segments.src: ### 3. Energy and Economic Spillovers
segments.tr: ### 3. Les retombées énergétiques et économiques

segments.src: The third bucket is less visible in the defense budget but can matter just as much to households.
segments.tr: Le troisième pôle est moins visible dans le budget de la défense, mais il peut compter tout autant pour les ménages.

segments.src: The Middle East is central to global oil and gas flows, and any threat to shipping lanes or production can raise energy prices.
segments.tr: Le Moyen-Orient est au centre des flux mondiaux de pétrole et de gaz, et toute menace pesant sur les voies de navigation ou la production peut faire monter les prix de l'énergie.

segments.src: Higher fuel costs affect:
segments.tr: Les coûts de carburant plus élevés affectent :

segments.src: - **The military itself**, which is one of the largest single energy consumers in the federal government.
segments.tr: - **L'armée elle-même**, qui est l'un des plus grands consommateurs individuels d'énergie du gouvernement fédéral.

segments.src: - **Consumers**, who may see the effect at the pump and in transportation and shipping costs.
segments.tr: - **Les consommateurs**, qui peuvent en voir l'effet à la pompe ainsi que dans les coûts de transport et d'expédition.

segments.src: - **Inflation and interest rates**, which in turn influence the government's own borrowing costs.
segments.tr: - **L'inflation et les taux d'intérêt**, qui influencent à leur tour les propres coûts d'emprunt du gouvernement.

segments.src: These effects are difficult to forecast and can fade quickly or persist, depending on events.
segments.tr: Ces effets sont difficiles à prévoir et peuvent s'estomper rapidement ou persister, selon les événements.

segments.src: They are still part of the real cost of a conflict, even though they never appear on a Pentagon spreadsheet.
segments.tr: Ils font néanmoins partie du coût réel d'un conflit, même s'ils n'apparaissent jamais sur un tableur du Pentagone.

segments.src: ## How Congress Pays for War
segments.tr: ## Comment le Congrès finance la guerre

segments.src: Congress has several ways to fund military action, and each has trade-offs.
segments.tr: Le Congrès dispose de plusieurs moyens pour financer l'action militaire, et chacun comporte des compromis.

segments.src: - **The regular defense appropriations bill.** This is the most transparent route, but it competes directly with every other priority under spending limits.
segments.tr: - **Le projet de loi de crédits de la défense ordinaire.** C'est la voie la plus transparente, mais elle entre directement en concurrence avec toutes les autres priorités sous les plafonds de dépenses.

segments.src: - **Supplemental appropriations.** These are emergency requests passed outside the regular process. They can move quickly, but they are often debated as stand-alone packages and can attract unrelated demands.
segments.tr: - **Les crédits supplémentaires.** Ce sont des demandes d'urgence votées en dehors de la procédure normale. Ils peuvent avancer rapidement, mais ils font souvent l'objet de débats en tant que paquets autonomes et peuvent attirer des demandes sans rapport.

segments.src: - **Overseas contingency-style accounts.** In past conflicts, designating funds as emergency or war-related allowed spending to sit outside normal budget caps. Critics have argued that this approach can blur the line between true war costs and routine expenses.
segments.tr: - **Les comptes de style contingence outre-mer.** Lors de conflits passés, la désignation de fonds comme urgents ou liés à la guerre a permis aux dépenses de se situer en dehors des plafonds budgétaires normaux. Des critiques ont fait valoir que cette approche peut brouiller la frontière entre les coûts de guerre réels et les dépenses de routine.

segments.src: Which route lawmakers choose has real consequences.
segments.tr: La voie choisie par les législateurs a de réelles conséquences.

segments.src: Emergency designations can ease pressure on other programs, but they also add to the deficit without an offset.
segments.tr: Les désignations d'urgence peuvent atténuer la pression sur d'autres programmes, mais elles alourdissent également le déficit sans compensation.

segments.src: Funding through the regular process forces trade-offs that some members would rather avoid.
segments.tr: Le financement par le processus régulier impose des compromis que certains membres préféreraient éviter.

segments.src: ## The Deficit Collision
