segments.src: War funding does not arrive in an empty room.
segments.tr: Le financement de la guerre n'arrive pas dans une pièce vide.

segments.src: The federal government is running large annual deficits, and interest payments on the national debt have become one of the fastest-growing parts of the budget.
segments.tr: Le gouvernement fédéral enregistre de importants déficits annuels, et les paiements d'intérêts sur la dette nationale sont devenus l'un des postes du budget qui connaît la croissance la plus rapide.

segments.src: In that setting, any new spending request raises a familiar question: should it be paid for, or added to the debt?
segments.tr: Dans ce contexte, toute nouvelle demande de dépenses soulève une question familière : doit-elle être financée ou ajoutée à la dette ?

segments.src: Deficit-minded lawmakers may argue that new defense spending should be offset with cuts or revenue elsewhere.
segments.tr: Les législateurs soucieux du déficit peuvent faire valoir que les nouvelles dépenses de défense devraient être compensées par des coupes ou des recettes ailleurs.

segments.src: Defense advocates may reply that national security needs cannot wait for a budget deal, and that delay can cost more in the long run.
segments.tr: Les défenseurs de la défense peuvent répondre que les besoins de sécurité nationale ne peuvent attendre un accord budgétaire et qu'un retard peut coûter plus cher à long terme.

segments.src: Both arguments have a long history in Congress, and neither side wins automatically.
segments.tr: Ces deux arguments ont une longue histoire au Congrès et aucun camp ne l'emporte automatiquement.

segments.src: The result is often a negotiation in which several groups hold leverage at once:
segments.tr: Le résultat est souvent une négociation dans laquelle plusieurs groupes détiennent simultanément un poids politique :

segments.src: 1. **Defense hawks** who want faster and larger investments in munitions and readiness.
segments.tr: 1. **Les faucons de la défense** qui souhaitent des investissements plus rapides et plus massifs dans les munitions et l'état de préparation.

segments.src: 2. **Fiscal conservatives** who want offsets or lower overall spending.
segments.tr: 2. **Les conservateurs fiscaux** qui veulent des compensations ou des dépenses globales réduites.

segments.src: 3. **Appropriators of both parties** who want to protect domestic programs, infrastructure and aid to their districts.
segments.tr: 3. **Les responsables des crédits des deux partis** qui veulent protéger les programmes intérieurs, les infrastructures et l'aide à leurs districts.

segments.src: 4. **Members skeptical of military involvement** who may use the budget as a way to question the mission itself.
segments.tr: 4. **Les membres sceptiques quant à l'implication militaire** qui peuvent utiliser le budget pour remettre en question la mission elle-même.

segments.src: ## Competing Priorities
segments.tr: ## Priorités concurrentes

segments.src: A war supplemental rarely travels alone.
segments.tr: Un supplément budgétaire pour la guerre voyage rarement seul.

segments.src: Other items often compete for attention at the same time, including aid to allies, border and security funding, disaster relief, and domestic priorities that members want to attach to a must-pass bill.
segments.tr: D'autres éléments se disputent souvent l'attention en même temps, notamment l'aide aux alliés, le financement de la sécurité frontalière, l'aide aux cataclysmes et les priorités nationales que les membres souhaitent rattacher à un projet de loi incontournable.

segments.src: The more items in a package, the harder it is to build a majority, but the more reasons different members have to vote yes.
segments.tr: Plus il y a d'éléments dans un paquet, plus il est difficile de dégager une majorité, mais plus les différents membres ont de raisons de voter oui.

segments.src: There are also longer-term defense questions.
segments.tr: Il y a aussi des questions de défense à plus long terme.

segments.src: Shipbuilding, aircraft modernization, missile defense and the industrial base all need sustained funding.
segments.tr: La construction navale, la modernisation des aéronefs, la défense antimissile et la base industrielle nécessitent toutes un financement soutenu.

segments.src: If a conflict absorbs a large share of available money, some of those long-term programs could be delayed or scaled back.
segments.tr: Si un conflit absorbe une grande partie de l'argent disponible, certains de ces programmes à long terme pourraient être retardés ou réduits.

segments.src: If instead Congress treats the conflict as a reason to spend more overall, the deficit pressure grows.
segments.tr: Si, au contraire, le Congrès considère le conflit comme une raison de dépenser davantage globalement, la pression sur le déficit augmente.

segments.src: ## What to Watch
segments.tr: ## Ce qu'il faut surveiller

segments.src: For readers trying to follow the debate, a few indicators are useful:
segments.tr: Pour les lecteurs qui essaient de suivre le débat, quelques indicateurs sont utiles :

segments.src: - **The size and structure of any funding request**, including whether it is labeled emergency spending.
segments.tr: - **La taille et la structure de toute demande de financement**, y compris si elle est qualifiée de dépense d'urgence.

segments.src: - **Whether munitions funding includes multiyear contracts**, which signal a longer-term rebuilding effort rather than a one-time refill.
segments.tr: - **Le fait que le financement des munitions comprenne des contrats pluriannuels**, ce qui indique un effort de reconstruction à plus long terme plutôt qu'un remplissage ponctuel.

segments.src: - **Cost estimates from independent sources**, such as the Congressional Budget Office and nonpartisan think tanks, which often differ from administration figures.
segments.tr: - **Les estimations de coûts provenant de sources indépendantes**, telles que le Bureau du budget du Congrès et des groupes de réflexion non partisans, qui diffèrent souvent des chiffres de l'administration.

segments.src: - **Energy market movements**, which can indicate whether the economic side of the conflict is growing.
segments.tr: - **Les mouvements du marché de l'énergie**, qui peuvent indiquer si la dimension économique du conflit s'amplifie.

segments.src: - **Statements on offsets**, which show how willing leaders are to pair new spending with cuts or revenue.
segments.tr: - **Les déclarations sur les compensations**, qui montrent dans quelle mesure les dirigeants sont disposés à associer de nouvelles dépenses à des réductions ou à des recettes.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## En résumé

segments.src: The cost of a conflict is more than the first number in a headline.
segments.tr: Le coût d'un conflit dépasse le premier chiffre d'un titre d'actualité.

segments.src: It combines operating expenses, the long and expensive work of rebuilding stockpiles, and economic effects that reach well beyond the military.
segments.tr: Il combine les dépenses opérationnelles, le travail long et coûteux de reconstruction des stocks et les effets économiques qui vont bien au-delà de l'armée.

segments.src: How Congress responds will depend on how long events last, how lawmakers weigh security against borrowing, and whether the parties can agree on what to fund and how.
segments.tr: La réaction du Congrès dépendra de la durée des événements, de la manière dont les législateurs évaluent la sécurité par rapport à l'emprunt et de la capacité des partis à s'entendre sur ce qu'il faut financer et comment.

segments.src: Whatever the outcome, the debate is likely to shape defense budgets and deficit discussions for years.
segments.tr: Quel que soit le résultat, le débat façonnera probablement les budgets de la défense et les discussions sur le déficit pendant des années.

segments.src: Readers who want to understand it should look past the headline total and ask what the money buys, who decides, and who ultimately pays.
segments.tr: Les lecteurs qui souhaitent le comprendre doivent regarder au-delà du total affiché dans le titre et se demander ce que l'argent achète, qui décide et qui paie en fin de compte.

pt.title: O Preço da Guerra: Como os Custos do Conflito com o Irã Podem Remodelar o Orçamento de Defesa e o Déficit

segments.src: ## Why the Bill Matters
segments.tr: ## Por Que a Conta Importa

segments.src: Every military operation comes with a price tag, and the final total is rarely the number first discussed.
segments.tr: Toda operação militar tem um preço, e o total final raramente é o valor discutido inicialmente.

segments.src: Flying aircraft, keeping ships at sea, moving troops and running air defenses all cost money.
segments.tr: Pilotar aeronaves, manter navios no mar, mover tropas e operar defesas aéreas custam dinheiro.

segments.src: So does replacing the weapons that get used.
segments.tr: O mesmo vale para a reposição das armas que são utilizadas.

segments.src: When a conflict involving Iran draws in U.S.
segments.tr: Quando um conflito envolvendo o Irã envolve forças dos

segments.src: forces or U.S.
segments.tr: EUA ou parceiros dos

segments.src: partners, those costs move from military planning documents into a budget debate in Washington.
segments.tr: EUA, esses custos passam de documentos de planejamento militar para um debate orçamentário em Washington.

segments.src: This article does not try to predict how any conflict will unfold.
segments.tr: Este artigo não tenta prever como qualquer conflito se desenrolará.

segments.src: It looks at the main categories of cost, how Congress usually pays for them, and why the timing is hard.
segments.tr: Ele analisa as principais categorias de custo, como o Congresso geralmente paga por elas e por que o timing é difícil.

segments.src: Federal borrowing is already high, and lawmakers are already divided over what to prioritize.
segments.tr: O endividamento federal já é alto, e os legisladores já estão divididos sobre o que priorizar.

segments.src: ## The Three Big Cost Buckets
segments.tr: ## Os Três Grandes Blocos de Custos

segments.src: ### 1. Operations
segments.tr: ### 1. Operações

segments.src: Operating costs are the day-to-day expenses of a deployment.
segments.tr: Os custos operacionais são as despesas diárias de um deslocamento.

segments.src: They include fuel, maintenance, flight hours, personnel pay and allowances, logistics and intelligence support.
segments.tr: Eles incluem combustível, manutenção, horas de voo, pagamento e auxílios de pessoal, logística e suporte de inteligência.

segments.src: Ships and aircraft that stay deployed longer than planned wear out faster.
segments.tr: Navios e aeronaves que permanecem destacados por mais tempo do que o planejado desgastam-se mais rapidamente.

segments.src: That raises maintenance needs and can shorten the time before major repairs are due.
segments.tr: Isso aumenta as necessidades de manutenção e pode encurtar o tempo antes que grandes reparos sejam necessários.

segments.src: Operating costs tend to grow with duration.
segments.tr: Os custos operacionais tendem a crescer com a duração.

segments.src: A short, limited operation may be absorbed within existing accounts.
segments.tr: Uma operação curta e limitada pode ser absorvida pelas contas existentes.

segments.src: A prolonged presence usually is not.
segments.tr: Uma presença prolongada geralmente não é.

segments.src: At that point the Pentagon often asks Congress for additional funds.
segments.tr: Nesse ponto, o Pentágono frequentemente pede fundos adicionais ao Congresso.

segments.src: ### 2. Munitions Replenishment
segments.tr: ### 2. Reposição de Munições

segments.src: The second bucket is often the hardest to fix quickly.
segments.tr: O segundo bloco costuma ser o mais difícil de consertar rapidamente.

segments.src: Interceptors, precision-guided weapons and long-range missiles are expensive.
segments.tr: Interceptadores, armas guiadas de precisão e mísseis de longo alcance são caros.

segments.src: They are also built by a small number of manufacturers on production lines that cannot simply be sped up.
segments.tr: Eles também são construídos por um pequeno número de fabricantes em linhas de produção que não podem ser simplesmente aceleradas.

segments.src: Defensive systems illustrate the problem.
segments.tr: Os sistemas defensivos ilustram o problema.

segments.src: An interceptor used to stop an incoming threat can cost far more than the threat itself.
segments.tr: Um interceptador usado para parar uma ameaça iminente pode custar muito mais do que a própria ameaça.

segments.src: Even when the exchange succeeds, the stockpile shrinks.
segments.tr: Mesmo quando a troca é bem-sucedida, o estoque diminui.

segments.src: Rebuilding it takes time, and the money has to be committed years ahead through multiyear contracts, factory expansion and supplier support.
segments.tr: Reconstruí-lo leva tempo, e o dinheiro precisa ser comprometido com anos de antecedência por meio de contratos plurianuais, expansão de fábricas e suporte de fornecedores.

segments.src: Analysts have repeatedly warned that U.S.
segments.tr: Os analistas têm alertado repetidamente que os estoques dos

segments.src: stockpiles of some key munitions are under strain from several demands at once.
segments.tr: EUA de algumas munições importantes estão sob pressão devido a várias demandas simultâneas.

segments.src: Those demands include support for partners and the need to stay ready for other regions.
segments.tr: Essas demandas incluem apoio a parceiros e a necessidade de permanecer pronto para outras regiões.

segments.src: A conflict that uses these weapons heavily could turn that strain into an urgent funding request.
segments.tr: Um conflito que use essas armas intensamente pode transformar essa pressão em um pedido urgente de financiamento.

segments.src: ### 3. Energy and Economic Spillovers
segments.tr: ### 3. Impactos de Energia e Econômicos

segments.src: The third bucket is less visible in the defense budget but can matter just as much to households.
segments.tr: O terceiro bloco é menos visível no orçamento de defesa, mas pode importar tanto para as famílias.

segments.src: The Middle East is central to global oil and gas flows, and any threat to shipping lanes or production can raise energy prices.
segments.tr: O Oriente Médio é central para os fluxos globais de petróleo e gás, e qualquer ameaça às rotas de navegação ou à produção pode elevar os preços da energia.

segments.src: Higher fuel costs affect:
segments.tr: Custos de combustível mais altos afetam:

segments.src: - **The military itself**, which is one of the largest single energy consumers in the federal government.
segments.tr: - **O próprio setor militar**, que é um dos maiores consumidores individuais de energia no governo federal.

segments.src: - **Consumers**, who may see the effect at the pump and in transportation and shipping costs.
segments.tr: - **Os consumidores**, que podem ver o efeito na bomba de gasolina e nos custos de transporte e frete.

segments.src: - **Inflation and interest rates**, which in turn influence the government's own borrowing costs.
segments.tr: - **A inflação e as taxas de juros**, que por sua vez influenciam os custos de empréstimo do próprio governo.

segments.src: These effects are difficult to forecast and can fade quickly or persist, depending on events.
segments.tr: Esses efeitos são difíceis de prever e podem desaparecer rapidamente ou persistir, dependendo dos eventos.

segments.src: They are still part of the real cost of a conflict, even though they never appear on a Pentagon spreadsheet.
segments.tr: Eles ainda fazem parte do custo real de um conflito, embora nunca apareçam em uma planilha do Pentágono.

segments.src: ## How Congress Pays for War
segments.tr: ## Como o Congresso Paga pela Guerra

segments.src: Congress has several ways to fund military action, and each has trade-offs.
segments.tr: O Congresso tem várias maneiras de financiar a ação militar, e cada uma tem compromissos e concessões.

segments.src: - **The regular defense appropriations bill.** This is the most transparent route, but it competes directly with every other priority under spending limits.
segments.tr: - **O projeto de lei de dotações regulares de defesa.** Esta é a rota mais transparente, mas compete diretamente com todas as outras prioridades sob os limites de gastos.

segments.src: - **Supplemental appropriations.** These are emergency requests passed outside the regular process. They can move quickly, but they are often debated as stand-alone packages and can attract unrelated demands.
segments.tr: - **Dotações suplementares.** São pedidos de emergência aprovados fora do processo regular. Eles podem avançar rapidamente, mas costumam ser debatidos como pacotes isolados e podem atrair demandas não relacionadas.

segments.src: - **Overseas contingency-style accounts.** In past conflicts, designating funds as emergency or war-related allowed spending to sit outside normal budget caps. Critics have argued that this approach can blur the line between true war costs and routine expenses.
segments.tr: - **Contas no estilo de contingência ultramarina.** Em conflitos passados, designar fundos como de emergência ou relacionados à guerra permitiu que os gastos ficassem fora dos limites normais do orçamento. Os críticos argumentam que essa abordagem pode borrar a linha entre os custos reais de guerra e as despesas rotineiras.

segments.src: Which route lawmakers choose has real consequences.
segments.tr: A rota que os legisladores escolhem tem consequências reais.

segments.src: Emergency designations can ease pressure on other programs, but they also add to the deficit without an offset.
segments.tr: As designações de emergência podem aliviar a pressão sobre outros programas, mas também aumentam o déficit sem uma compensação.

segments.src: Funding through the regular process forces trade-offs that some members would rather avoid.
segments.tr: O financiamento por meio do processo regular força trocas que alguns membros prefeririam evitar.

segments.src: ## The Deficit Collision
segments.tr: ## A Colisão do Déficit

segments.src: War funding does not arrive in an empty room.
segments.tr: O financiamento de guerra não chega em uma sala vazia.

segments.src: In that setting, any new spending request raises a familiar question: should it be paid for, or added to the debt?

segments.src: Defense advocates may reply that national security needs cannot wait for a budget deal, and that delay can cost more in the long run.
segments.tr: Os defensores da defesa podem responder que as necessidades de segurança nacional não podem esperar por um acordo orçamentário e que o atraso pode custar mais a longo prazo.

segments.src: Both arguments have a long history in Congress, and neither side wins automatically.
segments.tr: Ambos os argumentos têm uma longa história no Congresso, e nenhum dos lados vence automaticamente.

segments.src: The result is often a negotiation in which several groups hold leverage at once:
segments.tr: O resultado costuma ser uma negociação em que vários grupos mantêm poder de barganha ao mesmo tempo:

segments.src: 1. **Defense hawks** who want faster and larger investments in munitions and readiness.
segments.tr: 1. **Falcões da defesa** que desejam investimentos mais rápidos e maiores em munições e prontidão.

segments.src: 2. **Fiscal conservatives** who want offsets or lower overall spending.
segments.tr: 2. **Conservadores fiscais** que desejam compensações ou gastos gerais menores.

segments.src: 3. **Appropriators of both parties** who want to protect domestic programs, infrastructure and aid to their districts.
segments.tr: 3. **Doutrinadores de ambos os partidos** que desejam proteger programas domésticos, infraestrutura e ajuda aos seus distritos.

segments.src: 4. **Members skeptical of military involvement** who may use the budget as a way to question the mission itself.

segments.tr: ## Prioridades Concorrentes

segments.src: The second bucket is often the hardest to fix quickly.

segments.src: Analysts have repeatedly warned that U.S.

segments.tr: AS untuk beberapa amunisi utama berada di bawah tekanan dari berbagai permintaan sekaligus.

segments.tr: Permintaan tersebut mencakup dukungan bagi para mitra dan kebutuhan untuk tetap siap menghadapi wilayah lain.

segments.src: A conflict that uses these weapons heavily could turn that strain into an urgent funding request.
segments.tr: Konflik yang menggunakan senjata-senjata ini secara besar-besaran dapat mengubah tekanan tersebut menjadi permintaan pendanaan yang mendesak.

segments.src: ### 3. Energy and Economic Spillovers
segments.tr: ### 3. Dampak Energi dan Ekonomi

segments.src: The third bucket is less visible in the defense budget but can matter just as much to households.
segments.tr: Ember ketiga kurang terlihat dalam anggaran pertahanan tetapi bisa sama pentingnya bagi rumah tangga.

segments.src: The Middle East is central to global oil and gas flows, and any threat to shipping lanes or production can raise energy prices.
segments.tr: Timur Tengah adalah pusat arus minyak dan gas global, dan setiap ancaman terhadap jalur pelayaran atau produksi dapat menaikkan harga energi.

segments.src: Higher fuel costs affect:
segments.tr: Biaya bahan bakar yang lebih tinggi memengaruhi:

segments.src: - **The military itself**, which is one of the largest single energy consumers in the federal government.
segments.tr: - **Militer itu sendiri**, yang merupakan salah satu konsumen energi tunggal terbesar di pemerintahan federal.

segments.src: - **Consumers**, who may see the effect at the pump and in transportation and shipping costs.
segments.tr: - **Konsumen**, yang mungkin melihat dampaknya di SPBU serta pada biaya transportasi dan pengiriman.

segments.src: - **Inflation and interest rates**, which in turn influence the government's own borrowing costs.
segments.tr: - **Inflasi dan suku bunga**, yang pada gilirannya memengaruhi biaya pinjaman pemerintah sendiri.

segments.src: These effects are difficult to forecast and can fade quickly or persist, depending on events.
segments.tr: Efek-efek ini sulit untuk diperkirakan dan dapat memudar dengan cepat atau bertahan, tergantung pada peristiwa yang terjadi.

segments.src: They are still part of the real cost of a conflict, even though they never appear on a Pentagon spreadsheet.
segments.tr: Efek-efek tersebut tetap merupakan bagian dari biaya nyata sebuah konflik, meskipun efek tersebut tidak pernah muncul di spreadsheet Pentagon.

segments.src: ## How Congress Pays for War
segments.tr: ## Bagaimana Kongres Membiayai Perang

segments.src: Congress has several ways to fund military action, and each has trade-offs.
segments.tr: Kongres memiliki beberapa cara untuk mendanai tindakan militer, dan masing-masing memiliki pertukaran.

segments.src: - **The regular defense appropriations bill.** This is the most transparent route, but it competes directly with every other priority under spending limits.
segments.tr: - **RUU alokasi pertahanan reguler.** Ini adalah jalur yang paling transparan, tetapi bersaing secara langsung dengan setiap prioritas lain di bawah batasan pengeluaran.

segments.src: - **Supplemental appropriations.** These are emergency requests passed outside the regular process. They can move quickly, but they are often debated as stand-alone packages and can attract unrelated demands.
segments.tr: - **Alokasi tambahan.** Ini adalah permintaan darurat yang disahkan di luar proses reguler. Permintaan ini dapat bergerak dengan cepat, tetapi sering kali diperdebatkan sebagai paket mandiri dan dapat menarik tuntutan yang tidak terkait.

segments.src: - **Overseas contingency-style accounts.** In past conflicts, designating funds as emergency or war-related allowed spending to sit outside normal budget caps. Critics have argued that this approach can blur the line between true war costs and routine expenses.
segments.tr: - **Akun bergaya kontinjensi luar negeri.** Dalam konflik-konflik sebelumnya, menetapkan dana sebagai darurat atau terkait perang memungkinkan pengeluaran berada di luar batasan anggaran normal. Para kritikus berpendapat bahwa pendekatan ini dapat mengaburkan batas antara biaya perang yang sebenarnya dan pengeluaran rutin.

segments.src: Which route lawmakers choose has real consequences.
segments.tr: Jalur mana yang dipilih oleh para pembuat undang-undang memiliki konsekuensi nyata.

segments.src: Emergency designations can ease pressure on other programs, but they also add to the deficit without an offset.
segments.tr: Penetapan darurat dapat meringankan tekanan pada program lain, tetapi juga menambah defisit tanpa tebusan.

segments.src: Funding through the regular process forces trade-offs that some members would rather avoid.
segments.tr: Pendanaan melalui proses reguler memaksa adanya kompromi yang lebih ingin dihindari oleh beberapa anggota.

segments.src: ## The Deficit Collision
segments.tr: ## Benturan Defisit

segments.src: War funding does not arrive in an empty room.
segments.tr: Pendanaan perang tidak datang di ruang kosong.

segments.src: The federal government is running large annual deficits, and interest payments on the national debt have become one of the fastest-growing parts of the budget.
segments.tr: Pemerintah federal mengalami defisit tahunan yang besar, dan pembayaran bunga atas utang nasional telah menjadi salah satu bagian anggaran yang tumbuh paling cepat.

segments.src: In that setting, any new spending request raises a familiar question: should it be paid for, or added to the debt?
segments.tr: Dalam situasi tersebut, setiap permintaan pengeluaran baru memunculkan pertanyaan yang sudah tidak asing lagi: apakah harus dibayar, atau ditambahkan ke utang?

segments.src: Deficit-minded lawmakers may argue that new defense spending should be offset with cuts or revenue elsewhere.
segments.tr: Anggota parlemen yang berpikiran tentang defisit mungkin berpendapat bahwa pengeluaran pertahanan baru harus diimbangi dengan pemotongan atau pendapatan di tempat lain.

segments.src: Defense advocates may reply that national security needs cannot wait for a budget deal, and that delay can cost more in the long run.
segments.tr: Para pendukung pertahanan mungkin membalas bahwa kebutuhan keamanan nasional tidak dapat menunggu kesepakatan anggaran, dan penundaan dapat merugikan lebih banyak dalam jangka panjang.

segments.src: Both arguments have a long history in Congress, and neither side wins automatically.
segments.tr: Kedua argumen tersebut memiliki sejarah panjang di Kongres, dan tidak ada pihak yang menang secara otomatis.

segments.src: The result is often a negotiation in which several groups hold leverage at once:
segments.tr: Hasilnya sering kali berupa negosiasi di mana beberapa kelompok memegang pengaruh sekaligus:

segments.src: 1. **Defense hawks** who want faster and larger investments in munitions and readiness.
segments.tr: 1. **Pemberhaluan pertahanan (Hawks)** yang menginginkan investasi yang lebih cepat dan lebih besar dalam amunisi dan kesiapan.

segments.src: 2. **Fiscal conservatives** who want offsets or lower overall spending.
segments.tr: 2. **Konservatif fiskal** yang menginginkan penggantian atau pengeluaran keseluruhan yang lebih rendah.

segments.src: 3. **Appropriators of both parties** who want to protect domestic programs, infrastructure and aid to their districts.
segments.tr: 3. **Penyusun alokasi dari kedua partai** yang ingin melindungi program domestik, infrastruktur, dan bantuan ke distrik mereka.

segments.src: 4. **Members skeptical of military involvement** who may use the budget as a way to question the mission itself.
segments.tr: 4. **Anggota yang skeptis terhadap keterlibatan militer** yang dapat menggunakan anggaran sebagai cara untuk mempertanyakan misi itu sendiri.

segments.src: ## Competing Priorities
segments.tr: ## Prioritas yang Bersaing

segments.src: A war supplemental rarely travels alone.
segments.tr: Suplemen perang jarang berjalan sendiri.

segments.src: Other items often compete for attention at the same time, including aid to allies, border and security funding, disaster relief, and domestic priorities that members want to attach to a must-pass bill.
segments.tr: Barang-barang lain sering kali bersaing untuk mendapatkan perhatian pada saat yang sama, termasuk bantuan kepada sekutu, pendanaan perbatasan dan keamanan, bantuan bencana, dan prioritas domestik yang ingin dilampirkan oleh para anggota pada RUU yang harus disahkan.

segments.src: The more items in a package, the harder it is to build a majority, but the more reasons different members have to vote yes.
segments.tr: Semakin banyak item dalam sebuah paket, semakin sulit untuk membangun mayoritas, tetapi semakin banyak alasan yang dimiliki oleh anggota yang berbeda untuk memilih ya.

segments.src: There are also longer-term defense questions.
segments.tr: Ada juga pertanyaan pertahanan jangka panjang.

segments.src: Shipbuilding, aircraft modernization, missile defense and the industrial base all need sustained funding.
segments.tr: Pembuatan kapal, modernisasi pesawat, pertahanan rudal, dan basis industri semuanya membutuhkan pendanaan yang berkelanjutan.

segments.src: If a conflict absorbs a large share of available money, some of those long-term programs could be delayed or scaled back.
segments.tr: Jika sebuah konflik menyerap sebagian besar dana yang tersedia, beberapa program jangka panjang tersebut dapat ditunda atau dikurangi.

segments.src: If instead Congress treats the conflict as a reason to spend more overall, the deficit pressure grows.
segments.tr: Jika sebaliknya Kongres memperlakukan konflik tersebut sebagai alasan untuk membelanjakan lebih banyak secara keseluruhan, tekanan defisit akan semakin besar.

segments.src: ## What to Watch
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Harus Diperhatikan

segments.src: For readers trying to follow the debate, a few indicators are useful:
segments.tr: Bagi pembaca yang mencoba mengikuti perdebatan tersebut, beberapa indikator berguna:

segments.src: - **The size and structure of any funding request**, including whether it is labeled emergency spending.
segments.tr: - **Ukuran dan struktur dari setiap permintaan pendanaan**, termasuk apakah itu diberi label pengeluaran darurat.

segments.src: - **Whether munitions funding includes multiyear contracts**, which signal a longer-term rebuilding effort rather than a one-time refill.
segments.tr: - **Apakah pendanaan amunisi mencakup kontrak multi-tahun**, yang menandakan upaya pembangunan kembali jangka panjang alih-alih pengisian ulang satu kali.

segments.src: - **Cost estimates from independent sources**, such as the Congressional Budget Office and nonpartisan think tanks, which often differ from administration figures.
segments.tr: - **Perkiraan biaya dari sumber independen**, seperti Kantor Anggaran Kongres dan lembaga pemikir nonpartisan, yang sering kali berbeda dari angka pemerintahan.

segments.src: - **Energy market movements**, which can indicate whether the economic side of the conflict is growing.
segments.tr: - **Pergerakan pasar energi**, yang dapat menunjukkan apakah sisi ekonomi dari konflik sedang berkembang.

segments.src: - **Statements on offsets**, which show how willing leaders are to pair new spending with cuts or revenue.
segments.tr: - **Pernyataan tentang pengimbangan**, yang menunjukkan seberapa besar kemauan para pemimpin untuk memasangkan pengeluaran baru dengan pemotongan atau pendapatan.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Garis Bawah

segments.src: The cost of a conflict is more than the first number in a headline.
segments.tr: Biaya sebuah konflik lebih dari sekadar angka pertama dalam tajuk berita.

segments.src: It combines operating expenses, the long and expensive work of rebuilding stockpiles, and economic effects that reach well beyond the military.
segments.tr: Biaya tersebut menggabungkan pengeluaran operasional, pekerjaan yang panjang dan mahal untuk membangun kembali persediaan, serta dampak ekonomi yang menjangkau jauh melampaui militer.

segments.src: How Congress responds will depend on how long events last, how lawmakers weigh security against borrowing, and whether the parties can agree on what to fund and how.
segments.tr: Bagaimana Kongres menanggapi akan bergantung pada berapa lama peristiwa berlangsung, bagaimana para pembuat undang-undang menimbang keamanan terhadap pinjaman, dan apakah para pihak dapat menyetujui apa yang harus didanai dan bagaimana caranya.

segments.src: Whatever the outcome, the debate is likely to shape defense budgets and deficit discussions for years.
segments.tr: Apa pun hasilnya, perdebatan tersebut kemungkinan besar akan membentuk anggaran pertahanan dan diskusi defisit selama bertahun-tahun.

segments.src: Readers who want to understand it should look past the headline total and ask what the money buys, who decides, and who ultimately pays.
segments.tr: Pembaca yang ingin memahaminya harus melihat melampaui total tajuk utama dan bertanya apa yang dibeli oleh uang tersebut, siapa yang memutuskan, dan siapa yang akhirnya membayar.

segments.src: ## How Congress Pays for War
segments.tr: ## 議会が戦争の費用をどう支払うか

segments.src: Congress has several ways to fund military action, and each has trade-offs.
segments.tr: 議会には軍事行動に資金を提供するいくつかの方法があり、それぞれにトレードオフがある。

segments.src: - **The regular defense appropriations bill.** This is the most transparent route, but it competes directly with every other priority under spending limits.
segments.tr: - **通常の防衛歳出法案。** これは最も透明性の高いルートだが、支出制限の下であらゆる他の優先事項と直接競合する。

segments.src: - **Supplemental appropriations.** These are emergency requests passed outside the regular process. They can move quickly, but they are often debated as stand-alone packages and can attract unrelated demands.
segments.tr: - **追加歳出。** これらは通常の手続きの外部で可決される緊急の要求である。迅速に動くことができるが、しばしば単体のパッケージとして議論され、無関係な要求を引きつける可能性がある。

segments.src: - **Overseas contingency-style accounts.** In past conflicts, designating funds as emergency or war-related allowed spending to sit outside normal budget caps. Critics have argued that this approach can blur the line between true war costs and routine expenses.
segments.tr: - **海外偶発事態型の勘定。** 過去の紛争では、資金を緊急または戦争関連として指定することで、支出を通常の予算キャップの外に置くことができた。批判者たちは、このアプローチが真の戦争コストと日常的な経費の境界線を曖昧にする可能性があると主張してきた。

segments.src: Which route lawmakers choose has real consequences.
segments.tr: 議員がどのルートを選ぶかには現実的な結果が伴う。

segments.src: Emergency designations can ease pressure on other programs, but they also add to the deficit without an offset.
segments.tr: 緊急指定は他のプログラムへのプレッシャーを和らげることができるが、相殺措置なしで赤字を増大させることにもなる。

segments.src: Funding through the regular process forces trade-offs that some members would rather avoid.
segments.tr: 通常の手続きを通じた資金調達は、一部の議員が避けたいとするトレードオフを強いる。

segments.src: ## The Deficit Collision
segments.tr: ## 財政赤字との衝突

segments.src: War funding does not arrive in an empty room.
segments.tr: 戦争資金は空っぽの部屋に届くわけではない。

segments.src: The federal government is running large annual deficits, and interest payments on the national debt have become one of the fastest-growing parts of the budget.
segments.tr: 連邦政府は巨額の年間赤字を計上しており、国債の利払いは予算の中で最も急速に成長している部分の一つとなっている。

segments.src: In that setting, any new spending request raises a familiar question: should it be paid for, or added to the debt?
segments.tr: そのような状況において、新たな支出の要求は馴染みのある疑問を提起する：それの財源を確保すべきか、それとも借金に上乗せすべきか？

segments.src: Deficit-minded lawmakers may argue that new defense spending should be offset with cuts or revenue elsewhere.
segments.tr: 財政規律を重視する議員は、新たな防衛支出は他の部分での削減や歳入で相殺されるべきだと主張するかもしれない。

segments.src: Defense advocates may reply that national security needs cannot wait for a budget deal, and that delay can cost more in the long run.
segments.tr: 防衛擁護派は、国家安全保障のニーズは予算合意を待つことはできず、遅れは長期的にはより大きなコストにつながると反論するかもしれない。

segments.src: Both arguments have a long history in Congress, and neither side wins automatically.
segments.tr: どちらの主張も議会において長い歴史があり、どちらの側が自動的に勝利することはない。

segments.src: The result is often a negotiation in which several groups hold leverage at once:
segments.tr: その結果しばしば、複数のグループが同時に影響力を握る交渉となる：

segments.src: 1. **Defense hawks** who want faster and larger investments in munitions and readiness.
segments.tr: 1. **防衛強硬派（ディフェンス・ホーク）**：弾薬と即応体制へのより迅速かつ多額の投資を望む者。

segments.src: 2. **Fiscal conservatives** who want offsets or lower overall spending.
segments.tr: 2. **財政保守派**：相殺措置や全体的な支出の削減を望む者。

segments.src: 3. **Appropriators of both parties** who want to protect domestic programs, infrastructure and aid to their districts.
segments.tr: 3. **両党の歳出委員**：国内プログラム、インフラ、自分たちの選挙区への支援を守りたい者。

segments.src: 4. **Members skeptical of military involvement** who may use the budget as a way to question the mission itself.
segments.tr: 4. **軍事関与に懐疑的な議員**：予算をミッションそのものに疑問を投げかける手段として利用するかもしれない者。

segments.src: ## Competing Priorities
segments.tr: ## 競合する優先事項

segments.src: A war supplemental rarely travels alone.
segments.tr: 戦争の追加予算案が単独で通過することはめったにない。

segments.src: Other items often compete for attention at the same time, including aid to allies, border and security funding, disaster relief, and domestic priorities that members want to attach to a must-pass bill.
segments.tr: 同盟国への支援、国境およびセキュリティの資金、災害救援、そして議員が可決必須の法案に付随させたい国内の優先事項など、他の項目が同時に注目を集めるために競い合う。

segments.src: The more items in a package, the harder it is to build a majority, but the more reasons different members have to vote yes.
segments.tr: パッケージ内の項目が増えるほど過半数を形成するのは難しくなるが、異なる議員が賛成票を投じる理由は増える。

segments.src: There are also longer-term defense questions.
segments.tr: より長期的な防衛上の疑問もある。

segments.src: Shipbuilding, aircraft modernization, missile defense and the industrial base all need sustained funding.
segments.tr: 造船、航空機の近代化、ミサイル防衛、そして産業基盤はすべて持続的な資金を必要としている。

segments.src: If a conflict absorbs a large share of available money, some of those long-term programs could be delayed or scaled back.
segments.tr: もし紛争が利用可能な資金の大部分を吸収してしまった場合、それらの長期プログラムの一部が遅延したり規模縮小されたりする可能性がある。

segments.src: If instead Congress treats the conflict as a reason to spend more overall, the deficit pressure grows.
segments.tr: もし議会が代わりに、その紛争を全体としてより多く支出する理由として扱った場合、赤字のプレッシャーが増大する。

segments.src: ## What to Watch
segments.tr: ## 注目すべき点

segments.src: For readers trying to follow the debate, a few indicators are useful:
segments.tr: この議論を追おうとする読者にとって、いくつかの指標が有用である：

segments.src: - **The size and structure of any funding request**, including whether it is labeled emergency spending.
segments.tr: - **あらゆる資金調達要求の規模と構造**：それが緊急支出としてラベル付けされているかどうかを含む。

segments.src: - **Whether munitions funding includes multiyear contracts**, which signal a longer-term rebuilding effort rather than a one-time refill.
segments.tr: - **弾薬資金に複数年契約が含まれているかどうか**：単発の補充ではなく、より長期的な再建努力を示唆している。

segments.src: - **Cost estimates from independent sources**, such as the Congressional Budget Office and nonpartisan think tanks, which often differ from administration figures.
segments.tr: - **独立した情報源からのコスト見積もり**：米議会予算局（CBO）や非党派のシンクタンクなどによるもので、これらは政権の数値とは異なることが多い。

segments.src: - **Energy market movements**, which can indicate whether the economic side of the conflict is growing.
segments.tr: - **エネルギー市場の動き**：紛争の経済的側面が拡大しているかどうかを示す可能性がある。

segments.src: - **Statements on offsets**, which show how willing leaders are to pair new spending with cuts or revenue.
segments.tr: - **相殺に関する声明**：指導者たちが新しい支出を削減や歳入と組み合わせる意思がどれほどあるかを示している。

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 結論

segments.src: The cost of a conflict is more than the first number in a headline.
segments.tr: 紛争のコストは、見出しにある最初の数字以上のものである。

segments.src: It combines operating expenses, the long and expensive work of rebuilding stockpiles, and economic effects that reach well beyond the military.
segments.tr: それは運用経費、備蓄を再構築するための長く高額な作業、そして軍隊の枠をはるかに超えて届く経済的影響を組み合わせたものである。

segments.src: How Congress responds will depend on how long events last, how lawmakers weigh security against borrowing, and whether the parties can agree on what to fund and how.
segments.tr: 議会がどう対応するかは、事態がどれくらい続くか、議員が安全保障と借金をどう比較衡量するか、そして各政党が何にどう資金を投じることで合意できるかによって決まる。

segments.src: Whatever the outcome, the debate is likely to shape defense budgets and deficit discussions for years.
segments.tr: どのような結果になろうとも、この議論は今後数年間にわたって防衛予算と財政赤字の議論を形作る可能性が高い。

segments.src: Readers who want to understand it should look past the headline total and ask what the money buys, who decides, and who ultimately pays.
segments.tr: それを理解したい読者は、見出しの合計を超えて、そのお金が何を買うのか、誰が決めるのか、そして最終的に誰が支払うのかを問うべきである。

segments.src: ## Why the Bill Matters
segments.tr: ## Warum die Rechnung wichtig ist

segments.src: Every military operation comes with a price tag, and the final total is rarely the number first discussed.
segments.tr: Jede Militäroperation hat ihren Preis, und die Gesamtsumme entspricht selten der zuerst diskutierten Zahl.

segments.src: Flying aircraft, keeping ships at sea, moving troops and running air defenses all cost money.
segments.tr: Das Fliegen von Flugzeugen, das Halten von Schiffen auf See, das Verlegen von Truppen und der Betrieb von Luftabwehr kosten Geld.

segments.src: So does replacing the weapons that get used.
segments.tr: Das Gleiche gilt für den Ersatz der eingesetzten Waffen.

segments.src: When a conflict involving Iran draws in U.S.
segments.tr: Wenn ein Konflikt mit dem Iran US-

segments.src: forces or U.S.
segments.tr: Streitkräfte oder US-

segments.src: partners, those costs move from military planning documents into a budget debate in Washington.
segments.tr: Partner einbezieht, wandern diese Kosten aus den militärischen Planungsdokumenten in eine Haushaltsdebatte in Washington.

segments.src: This article does not try to predict how any conflict will unfold.
segments.tr: Dieser Artikel versucht nicht vorherzusagen, wie sich ein Konflikt entwickeln wird.

segments.src: It looks at the main categories of cost, how Congress usually pays for them, and why the timing is hard.
segments.tr: Er betrachtet die Hauptkostenkategorien, wie der Kongress sie normalerweise bezahlt und warum das Timing schwierig ist.

segments.src: Federal borrowing is already high, and lawmakers are already divided over what to prioritize.
segments.tr: Die Staatsverschuldung ist bereits hoch, und die Gesetzgeber sind sich bereits uneins darüber, was priorisiert werden soll.

segments.src: ## The Three Big Cost Buckets
segments.tr: ## Die drei großen Kostenblöcke

segments.src: ### 1. Operations
segments.tr: ### 1. Operationen

segments.src: Operating costs are the day-to-day expenses of a deployment.
segments.tr: Die Betriebskosten sind die täglichen Ausgaben eines Einsatzes.

segments.src: They include fuel, maintenance, flight hours, personnel pay and allowances, logistics and intelligence support.
segments.tr: Sie umfassen Treibstoff, Wartung, Flugstunden, Personalbezüge und -zulagen, Logistik und Geheimdienstunterstützung.

segments.src: Ships and aircraft that stay deployed longer than planned wear out faster.
segments.tr: Schiffe und Flugzeuge, die länger im Einsatz bleiben als geplant, verschleißen schneller.

segments.src: That raises maintenance needs and can shorten the time before major repairs are due.
segments.tr: Das erhöht den Wartungsbedarf und kann die Zeit bis zu größeren Reparaturen verkürzen.

segments.src: Operating costs tend to grow with duration.
segments.tr: Die Betriebskosten tendieren dazu, mit der Dauer zu steigen.

segments.src: A short, limited operation may be absorbed within existing accounts.
segments.tr: Eine kurze, begrenzte Operation kann möglicherweise in bestehenden Konten aufgefangen werden.

segments.src: A prolonged presence usually is not.
segments.tr: Eine längere Präsenz tut das in der Regel nicht.

segments.src: At that point the Pentagon often asks Congress for additional funds.
segments.tr: Zu diesem Zeitpunkt bittet das Pentagon den Kongress oft um zusätzliche Mittel.

segments.src: ### 2. Munitions Replenishment
segments.tr: ### 2. Munitionsnachschub

segments.src: The second bucket is often the hardest to fix quickly.
segments.tr: Der zweite Block ist oft am schwersten schnell zu beheben.

segments.src: Interceptors, precision-guided weapons and long-range missiles are expensive.
segments.tr: Abfangjäger, präzisionsgelenkte Waffen und Langstreckenraketen sind teuer.

segments.src: They are also built by a small number of manufacturers on production lines that cannot simply be sped up.
segments.tr: Sie werden zudem von einer kleinen Anzahl von Herstellern auf Produktionslinien gebaut, die sich nicht einfach beschleunigen lassen.

segments.src: Defensive systems illustrate the problem.
segments.tr: Abwehrsysteme veranschaulichen das Problem.

segments.src: An interceptor used to stop an incoming threat can cost far more than the threat itself.
segments.tr: Ein Abfangjäger, der eingesetzt wird, um eine ankommende Bedrohung zu stoppen, kann viel mehr kosten als die Bedrohung selbst.

segments.src: Even when the exchange succeeds, the stockpile shrinks.
segments.tr: Selbst wenn der Austausch erfolgreich ist, schrumpft der Vorrat.

segments.src: Rebuilding it takes time, and the money has to be committed years ahead through multiyear contracts, factory expansion and supplier support.
segments.tr: Ihn wiederaufzubauen braucht Zeit, und das Geld muss Jahre im Voraus durch mehrjährige Verträge, Fabrikexpansion und Unterstützung der Lieferanten zugesagt werden.

segments.src: Analysts have repeatedly warned that U.S.
segments.tr: Analysten haben wiederholt davor gewarnt, dass die US-

segments.src: stockpiles of some key munitions are under strain from several demands at once.
segments.tr: Bestände an einigen wichtigen Munitionsarten durch mehrere Anforderungen gleichzeitig beansprucht werden.

segments.src: Those demands include support for partners and the need to stay ready for other regions.
segments.tr: Diese Anforderungen umfassen Unterstützung für Partner und die Notwendigkeit, für andere Regionen einsatzbereit zu bleiben.

segments.src: A conflict that uses these weapons heavily could turn that strain into an urgent funding request.
segments.tr: Ein Konflikt, der diese Waffen intensiv nutzt, könnte diese Belastung in eine dringende Finanzierungsanfrage verwandeln.

segments.src: ### 3. Energy and Economic Spillovers
segments.tr: ### 3. Energie- und Wirtschaftsauswirkungen

segments.src: The third bucket is less visible in the defense budget but can matter just as much to households.
segments.tr: Der dritte Block ist im Verteidigungshaushalt weniger sichtbar, kann aber für Haushalte genauso wichtig sein.

segments.src: The Middle East is central to global oil and gas flows, and any threat to shipping lanes or production can raise energy prices.
segments.tr: Der Nahe Osten ist von zentraler Bedeutung für die globalen Öl- und Gasströme, und jede Bedrohung der Seewege oder der Produktion kann die Energiepreise steigen lassen.

segments.src: Higher fuel costs affect:
segments.tr: Höhere Treibstoffkosten betreffen:

segments.src: - **The military itself**, which is one of the largest single energy consumers in the federal government.
segments.tr: - **Das Militär selbst**, das einer der größten einzelnen Energieverbraucher in der Bundesregierung ist.

segments.src: - **Consumers**, who may see the effect at the pump and in transportation and shipping costs.
segments.tr: - **Verbraucher**, die die Auswirkungen an der Zapfsäule sowie bei Transport- und Versandkosten spüren können.

segments.src: - **Inflation and interest rates**, which in turn influence the government's own borrowing costs.
segments.tr: - **Inflation und Zinssätze**, die wiederum die eigenen Kreditkosten der Regierung beeinflussen.

segments.src: These effects are difficult to forecast and can fade quickly or persist, depending on events.
segments.tr: Diese Effekte sind schwer vorherzusagen und können je nach Ereignissen schnell abklingen oder anhalten.

segments.src: They are still part of the real cost of a conflict, even though they never appear on a Pentagon spreadsheet.
segments.tr: Sie sind dennoch Teil der realen Kosten eines Konflikts, auch wenn sie nie in einer Pentagon-Tabelle auftauchen.

segments.src: If instead Congress treats the conflict as a reason to spend more overall, the deficit pressure grows.
segments.tr: Wenn der Kongress den Konflikt stattdessen als Grund ansieht, insgesamt mehr auszugeben, wächst der Defizitdruck.

segments.src: ## What to Watch
segments.tr: ## Worauf zu achten ist

segments.src: For readers trying to follow the debate, a few indicators are useful:
segments.tr: Für Leser, die versuchen, der Debatte zu folgen, sind einige Indikatoren nützlich:

segments.src: - **The size and structure of any funding request**, including whether it is labeled emergency spending.
segments.tr: - **Die Größe und Struktur jeder Finanzierungsanfrage**, einschließlich der Frage, ob sie als Notfallausgabe deklariert ist.

segments.src: - **Whether munitions funding includes multiyear contracts**, which signal a longer-term rebuilding effort rather than a one-time refill.
segments.tr: - **Ob die Munitionsfinanzierung mehrjährige Verträge beinhaltet**, die eher eine langfristige Wiederaufbaubemühung als eine einmalige Auffüllung signalisieren.

segments.src: - **Cost estimates from independent sources**, such as the Congressional Budget Office and nonpartisan think tanks, which often differ from administration figures.
segments.tr: - **Kostenschätzungen aus unabhängigen Quellen**, wie dem Congressional Budget Office und überparteilichen Think Tanks, die oft von den Zahlen der Regierung abweichen.

segments.src: - **Energy market movements**, which can indicate whether the economic side of the conflict is growing.
segments.tr: - **Entwicklungen am Energiemarkt**, die darauf hinweisen können, ob die wirtschaftliche Seite des Konflikts wächst.

segments.src: - **Statements on offsets**, which show how willing leaders are to pair new spending with cuts or revenue.
segments.tr: - **Aussagen zu Ausgleichen**, die zeigen, wie bereitwillig die Führung ist, neue Ausgaben mit Kürzungen oder Einnahmen zu paaren.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Das Fazit

segments.src: The cost of a conflict is more than the first number in a headline.
segments.tr: Die Kosten eines Konflikts sind mehr als die erste Zahl in einer Schlagzeile.

segments.src: It combines operating expenses, the long and expensive work of rebuilding stockpiles, and economic effects that reach well beyond the military.
segments.tr: Sie kombinieren Betriebsausgaben, die lange und teure Arbeit des Wiederaufbaus von Beständen und wirtschaftliche Auswirkungen, die weit über das Militär hinausreichen.

segments.src: How Congress responds will depend on how long events last, how lawmakers weigh security against borrowing, and whether the parties can agree on what to fund and how.
segments.tr: Wie der Kongress reagiert, hängt davon ab, wie lange Ereignisse dauern, wie Gesetzgeber Sicherheit gegen Kreditaufnahme abwägen und ob sich die Parteien darauf einigen können, was und wie zu finanzieren ist.

segments.src: Whatever the outcome, the debate is likely to shape defense budgets and deficit discussions for years.
segments.tr: Unabhängig vom Ausgang wird die Debatte wahrscheinlich die Verteidigungshaushalte und Defizitdiskussionen für Jahre prägen.

segments.src: Readers who want to understand it should look past the headline total and ask what the money buys, who decides, and who ultimately pays.
segments.tr: Leser, die dies verstehen wollen, sollten über die Gesamtsumme der Schlagzeile hinausblicken und fragen, was das Geld kauft, wer entscheidet und wer letztendlich bezahlt.

vi.title: Cái giá của chiến tranh: Chi phí xung đột Iran có thể định hình lại ngân sách quốc phòng và thâm hụt ngân sách như thế nào

segments.src: ## Why the Bill Matters
segments.tr: ## Tại sao dự luật này lại quan trọng

segments.src: Every military operation comes with a price tag, and the final total is rarely the number first discussed.
segments.tr: Mọi hoạt động quân sự đều đi kèm với một cái giá, và tổng chi phí cuối cùng hiếm khi là con số được thảo luận ban đầu.

segments.src: Flying aircraft, keeping ships at sea, moving troops and running air defenses all cost money.
segments.tr: Việc vận hành máy bay, duy trì tàu trên biển, di chuyển quân đội và vận hành hệ thống phòng không đều tốn kém.

segments.src: So does replacing the weapons that get used.
segments.tr: Việc thay thế các loại vũ khí đã qua sử dụng cũng vậy.

segments.src: When a conflict involving Iran draws in U.S.
segments.tr: Khi một cuộc xung đột liên quan đến Iran lôi kéo lực lượng Hoa Kỳ

segments.src: forces or U.S.
segments.tr: hoặc các đối tác của Hoa Kỳ

segments.src: partners, those costs move from military planning documents into a budget debate in Washington.
segments.tr: vào cuộc, những chi phí đó sẽ chuyển từ các tài liệu kế hoạch quân sự sang một cuộc tranh luận về ngân sách tại Washington.

segments.src: This article does not try to predict how any conflict will unfold.
segments.tr: Bài viết này không cố gắng dự đoán bất kỳ cuộc xung đột nào sẽ diễn ra như thế nào.

segments.src: It looks at the main categories of cost, how Congress usually pays for them, and why the timing is hard.
segments.tr: Nó xem xét các loại chi phí chính, cách Quốc hội thường chi trả cho chúng và lý do tại sao thời điểm lại là vấn đề khó khăn.

segments.src: Federal borrowing is already high, and lawmakers are already divided over what to prioritize.
segments.tr: Nợ liên bang đã ở mức cao và các nhà lập pháp đã bị chia rẽ về việc nên ưu tiên điều gì.

segments.src: ## The Three Big Cost Buckets
segments.tr: ## Ba nhóm chi phí lớn

segments.src: ### 1. Operations
segments.tr: ### 1. Hoạt động

segments.src: Operating costs are the day-to-day expenses of a deployment.
segments.tr: Chi phí vận hành là các khoản chi tiêu hàng ngày cho việc triển khai quân.

segments.src: They include fuel, maintenance, flight hours, personnel pay and allowances, logistics and intelligence support.
segments.tr: Chúng bao gồm nhiên liệu, bảo trì, giờ bay, lương và phụ cấp nhân sự, hỗ trợ hậu cần và tình báo.

segments.src: Ships and aircraft that stay deployed longer than planned wear out faster.
segments.tr: Tàu và máy bay được triển khai lâu hơn kế hoạch sẽ nhanh bị hao mòn hơn.

segments.src: That raises maintenance needs and can shorten the time before major repairs are due.
segments.tr: Điều đó làm tăng nhu cầu bảo trì và có thể rút ngắn thời gian trước khi cần sửa chữa lớn.

segments.src: Operating costs tend to grow with duration.
segments.tr: Chi phí vận hành có xu hướng tăng theo thời gian.

segments.src: A short, limited operation may be absorbed within existing accounts.
segments.tr: Một hoạt động ngắn hạn, hạn chế có thể được hấp thụ trong các tài khoản hiện có.

segments.src: A prolonged presence usually is not.
segments.tr: Một sự hiện diện kéo dài thường không như vậy.

segments.src: At that point the Pentagon often asks Congress for additional funds.
segments.tr: Tại thời điểm đó, Lầu Năm Góc thường yêu cầu Quốc hội cấp thêm ngân sách.

segments.src: ### 2. Munitions Replenishment
segments.tr: ### 2. Bổ sung đạn dược

segments.src: The second bucket is often the hardest to fix quickly.
segments.tr: Nhóm thứ hai thường là nhóm khó khắc phục nhanh nhất.

segments.src: Interceptors, precision-guided weapons and long-range missiles are expensive.
segments.tr: Tên lửa đánh chặn, vũ khí dẫn đường chính xác và tên lửa tầm xa rất đắt đỏ.

segments.src: They are also built by a small number of manufacturers on production lines that cannot simply be sped up.
segments.tr: Chúng cũng được chế tạo bởi một số ít nhà sản xuất trên các dây chuyền sản xuất không thể đơn giản là tăng tốc độ.

segments.src: Defensive systems illustrate the problem.
segments.tr: Các hệ thống phòng thủ minh họa cho vấn đề này.

segments.src: An interceptor used to stop an incoming threat can cost far more than the threat itself.
segments.tr: Một tên lửa đánh chặn được sử dụng để ngăn chặn một mối đe dọa sắp tới có thể tốn kém hơn nhiều so với chính mối đe dọa đó.

segments.src: Even when the exchange succeeds, the stockpile shrinks.
segments.tr: Ngay cả khi cuộc trao đổi thành công, kho dự trữ vẫn bị thu hẹp.

segments.src: Rebuilding it takes time, and the money has to be committed years ahead through multiyear contracts, factory expansion and supplier support.
segments.tr: Việc xây dựng lại cần có thời gian và tiền bạc phải được cam kết trước nhiều năm thông qua các hợp đồng nhiều năm, mở rộng nhà máy và hỗ trợ nhà cung cấp.

segments.src: Analysts have repeatedly warned that U.S.
segments.tr: Các nhà phân tích đã nhiều lần cảnh báo rằng kho dự trữ

segments.src: stockpiles of some key munitions are under strain from several demands at once.
segments.tr: của Hoa Kỳ về một số loại đạn dược quan trọng đang bị căng thẳng do nhiều nhu cầu cùng một lúc.

segments.src: Those demands include support for partners and the need to stay ready for other regions.
segments.tr: Những nhu cầu đó bao gồm hỗ trợ cho các đối tác và nhu cầu duy trì sự sẵn sàng cho các khu vực khác.

segments.src: A conflict that uses these weapons heavily could turn that strain into an urgent funding request.
segments.tr: Một cuộc xung đột sử dụng nhiều các loại vũ khí này có thể biến sự căng thẳng đó thành một yêu cầu tài trợ khẩn cấp.

segments.src: ### 3. Energy and Economic Spillovers
segments.tr: ### 3. Năng lượng và tác động kinh tế lan tỏa

segments.src: The third bucket is less visible in the defense budget but can matter just as much to households.
segments.tr: Nhóm thứ ba ít được nhìn thấy trong ngân sách quốc phòng nhưng có thể quan trọng không kém đối với các hộ gia đình.

segments.src: The Middle East is central to global oil and gas flows, and any threat to shipping lanes or production can raise energy prices.
segments.tr: Trung Đông là trung tâm của dòng chảy dầu và khí đốt toàn cầu, và bất kỳ mối đe dọa nào đối với các tuyến đường vận chuyển hoặc sản xuất đều có thể làm tăng giá năng lượng.

segments.src: Higher fuel costs affect:
segments.tr: Chi phí nhiên liệu cao hơn ảnh hưởng đến:

segments.src: - **The military itself**, which is one of the largest single energy consumers in the federal government.
segments.tr: - **Bản thân quân đội**, vốn là một trong những đơn vị tiêu thụ năng lượng lớn nhất trong chính phủ liên bang.

segments.src: - **Consumers**, who may see the effect at the pump and in transportation and shipping costs.
segments.tr: - **Người tiêu dùng**, những người có thể thấy tác động tại các trạm xăng và trong chi phí vận chuyển và giao hàng.

segments.src: - **Inflation and interest rates**, which in turn influence the government's own borrowing costs.
segments.tr: - **Lạm phát và lãi suất**, từ đó ảnh hưởng đến chi phí vay của chính phủ.

segments.src: These effects are difficult to forecast and can fade quickly or persist, depending on events.
segments.tr: Những tác động này rất khó dự báo và có thể nhanh chóng biến mất hoặc kéo dài, tùy thuộc vào các sự kiện.

segments.src: They are still part of the real cost of a conflict, even though they never appear on a Pentagon spreadsheet.
segments.tr: Chúng vẫn là một phần của chi phí thực tế của một cuộc xung đột, mặc dù chúng không bao giờ xuất hiện trên bảng tính của Lầu Năm Góc.

segments.src: ## How Congress Pays for War
segments.tr: ## Cách Quốc hội chi trả cho chiến tranh

segments.src: Congress has several ways to fund military action, and each has trade-offs.
segments.tr: Quốc hội có nhiều cách để tài trợ cho hành động quân sự, và mỗi cách đều có những sự đánh đổi.

segments.src: - **The regular defense appropriations bill.** This is the most transparent route, but it competes directly with every other priority under spending limits.
segments.tr: - **Dự luật phân bổ ngân sách quốc phòng thường xuyên.** Đây là con đường minh bạch nhất, nhưng nó cạnh tranh trực tiếp với mọi ưu tiên khác trong giới hạn chi tiêu.

segments.src: - **Supplemental appropriations.** These are emergency requests passed outside the regular process. They can move quickly, but they are often debated as stand-alone packages and can attract unrelated demands.
segments.tr: - **Phân bổ ngân sách bổ sung.** Đây là các yêu cầu khẩn cấp được thông qua ngoài quy trình thông thường. Chúng có thể được thực hiện nhanh chóng, nhưng thường được tranh luận như các gói độc lập và có thể thu hút các yêu cầu không liên quan.

segments.src: - **Overseas contingency-style accounts.** In past conflicts, designating funds as emergency or war-related allowed spending to sit outside normal budget caps. Critics have argued that this approach can blur the line between true war costs and routine expenses.
segments.tr: - **Các tài khoản kiểu dự phòng ở nước ngoài.** Trong các cuộc xung đột trước đây, việc chỉ định các khoản tiền là khẩn cấp hoặc liên quan đến chiến tranh cho phép chi tiêu nằm ngoài các giới hạn ngân sách thông thường. Các nhà phê bình cho rằng cách tiếp cận này có thể làm mờ ranh giới giữa chi phí chiến tranh thực sự và chi phí thường xuyên.

segments.src: Which route lawmakers choose has real consequences.
segments.tr: Các nhà lập pháp chọn con đường nào đều có những hậu quả thực tế.

segments.src: Emergency designations can ease pressure on other programs, but they also add to the deficit without an offset.
segments.tr: Việc chỉ định khẩn cấp có thể giảm bớt áp lực lên các chương trình khác, nhưng chúng cũng làm tăng thâm hụt mà không có sự bù đắp.

segments.src: Funding through the regular process forces trade-offs that some members would rather avoid.
segments.tr: Việc tài trợ thông qua quy trình thông thường buộc phải có những sự đánh đổi mà một số thành viên muốn tránh.

segments.src: ## The Deficit Collision
segments.tr: ## Sự va chạm về thâm hụt

segments.src: War funding does not arrive in an empty room.
segments.tr: Việc tài trợ cho chiến tranh không đến trong một căn phòng trống.

segments.src: The federal government is running large annual deficits, and interest payments on the national debt have become one of the fastest-growing parts of the budget.
segments.tr: Chính phủ liên bang đang chịu thâm hụt hàng năm lớn, và các khoản thanh toán lãi nợ quốc gia đã trở thành một trong những phần tăng trưởng nhanh nhất của ngân sách.

segments.src: In that setting, any new spending request raises a familiar question: should it be paid for, or added to the debt?
segments.tr: Trong bối cảnh đó, bất kỳ yêu cầu chi tiêu mới nào cũng đặt ra một câu hỏi quen thuộc: liệu nó nên được chi trả hay cộng vào nợ công?

segments.src: Deficit-minded lawmakers may argue that new defense spending should be offset with cuts or revenue elsewhere.
segments.tr: Các nhà lập pháp quan tâm đến thâm hụt có thể lập luận rằng chi tiêu quốc phòng mới nên được bù đắp bằng việc cắt giảm hoặc doanh thu ở nơi khác.

segments.src: Defense advocates may reply that national security needs cannot wait for a budget deal, and that delay can cost more in the long run.
segments.tr: Những người ủng hộ quốc phòng có thể trả lời rằng nhu cầu an ninh quốc gia không thể chờ đợi một thỏa thuận ngân sách, và sự chậm trễ có thể tốn kém hơn về lâu dài.

segments.src: Both arguments have a long history in Congress, and neither side wins automatically.
segments.tr: Cả hai lập luận đều có lịch sử lâu dài tại Quốc hội, và không bên nào thắng tự động.

segments.src: The result is often a negotiation in which several groups hold leverage at once:
segments.tr: Kết quả thường là một cuộc đàm phán trong đó một số nhóm nắm giữ đòn bẩy cùng một lúc:

segments.src: 1. **Defense hawks** who want faster and larger investments in munitions and readiness.
segments.tr: 1. **Những người ủng hộ quốc phòng cứng rắn** muốn đầu tư nhanh hơn và lớn hơn vào đạn dược và sự sẵn sàng.

segments.src: 2. **Fiscal conservatives** who want offsets or lower overall spending.
segments.tr: 2. **Những người bảo thủ về tài chính** muốn bù đắp hoặc giảm chi tiêu tổng thể.

segments.src: 3. **Appropriators of both parties** who want to protect domestic programs, infrastructure and aid to their districts.
segments.tr: 3. **Các nhà phân bổ ngân sách của cả hai đảng** muốn bảo vệ các chương trình trong nước, cơ sở hạ tầng và viện trợ cho các khu vực của họ.

segments.src: 4. **Members skeptical of military involvement** who may use the budget as a way to question the mission itself.
segments.tr: 4. **Các thành viên hoài nghi về sự tham gia quân sự** có thể sử dụng ngân sách như một cách để đặt câu hỏi về chính sứ mệnh đó.

segments.src: ## Competing Priorities
segments.tr: ## Các ưu tiên cạnh tranh

segments.src: A war supplemental rarely travels alone.
segments.tr: Một khoản bổ sung cho chiến tranh hiếm khi đi một mình.

segments.src: Other items often compete for attention at the same time, including aid to allies, border and security funding, disaster relief, and domestic priorities that members want to attach to a must-pass bill.
segments.tr: Các mục khác thường cạnh tranh để được chú ý cùng lúc, bao gồm viện trợ cho các đồng minh, tài trợ cho biên giới và an ninh, cứu trợ thiên tai và các ưu tiên trong nước mà các thành viên muốn gắn vào một dự luật bắt buộc phải thông qua.

segments.src: The more items in a package, the harder it is to build a majority, but the more reasons different members have to vote yes.
segments.tr: Càng nhiều mục trong một gói, càng khó để xây dựng đa số, nhưng càng có nhiều lý do để các thành viên khác nhau bỏ phiếu thuận.

segments.src: There are also longer-term defense questions.
segments.tr: Cũng có những câu hỏi quốc phòng dài hạn hơn.

segments.src: Shipbuilding, aircraft modernization, missile defense and the industrial base all need sustained funding.
segments.tr: Đóng tàu, hiện đại hóa máy bay, phòng thủ tên lửa và cơ sở công nghiệp đều cần nguồn tài trợ bền vững.

segments.src: If a conflict absorbs a large share of available money, some of those long-term programs could be delayed or scaled back.
segments.tr: Nếu một cuộc xung đột chiếm một phần lớn số tiền sẵn có, một số chương trình dài hạn đó có thể bị trì hoãn hoặc thu hẹp quy mô.

segments.src: If instead Congress treats the conflict as a reason to spend more overall, the deficit pressure grows.
segments.tr: Nếu thay vào đó, Quốc hội coi cuộc xung đột là lý do để chi tiêu nhiều hơn nói chung, áp lực thâm hụt sẽ tăng lên.

segments.src: ## What to Watch
segments.tr: ## Những điều cần theo dõi

segments.src: For readers trying to follow the debate, a few indicators are useful:
segments.tr: Đối với độc giả đang cố gắng theo dõi cuộc tranh luận, một vài chỉ số rất hữu ích:

segments.src: - **The size and structure of any funding request**, including whether it is labeled emergency spending.
segments.tr: - **Quy mô và cấu trúc của bất kỳ yêu cầu tài trợ nào**, bao gồm cả việc liệu nó có được dán nhãn là chi tiêu khẩn cấp hay không.

segments.src: - **Whether munitions funding includes multiyear contracts**, which signal a longer-term rebuilding effort rather than a one-time refill.
segments.tr: - **Việc tài trợ đạn dược có bao gồm các hợp đồng nhiều năm hay không**, điều này báo hiệu một nỗ lực xây dựng lại dài hạn thay vì chỉ bổ sung một lần.

segments.src: - **Cost estimates from independent sources**, such as the Congressional Budget Office and nonpartisan think tanks, which often differ from administration figures.
segments.tr: - **Ước tính chi phí từ các nguồn độc lập**, chẳng hạn như Văn phòng Ngân sách Quốc hội và các tổ chức tư vấn phi đảng phái, thường khác với các số liệu của chính quyền.

segments.src: - **Energy market movements**, which can indicate whether the economic side of the conflict is growing.
segments.tr: - **Biến động thị trường năng lượng**, có thể cho biết liệu khía cạnh kinh tế của cuộc xung đột có đang gia tăng hay không.

segments.src: - **Statements on offsets**, which show how willing leaders are to pair new spending with cuts or revenue.
segments.tr: - **Các tuyên bố về bù đắp**, cho thấy các nhà lãnh đạo sẵn sàng kết hợp chi tiêu mới với việc cắt giảm hoặc doanh thu như thế nào.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Điểm mấu chốt

segments.src: The cost of a conflict is more than the first number in a headline.
segments.tr: Chi phí của một cuộc xung đột không chỉ là con số đầu tiên trên tiêu đề.

segments.src: It combines operating expenses, the long and expensive work of rebuilding stockpiles, and economic effects that reach well beyond the military.
segments.tr: Nó kết hợp chi phí vận hành, công việc xây dựng lại kho dự trữ lâu dài và tốn kém, và các tác động kinh tế vượt xa quân đội.

segments.src: How Congress responds will depend on how long events last, how lawmakers weigh security against borrowing, and whether the parties can agree on what to fund and how.
segments.tr: Cách Quốc hội phản ứng sẽ phụ thuộc vào việc các sự kiện kéo dài bao lâu, các nhà lập pháp cân nhắc an ninh so với vay mượn như thế nào, và liệu các đảng có thể đồng ý về những gì cần tài trợ và bằng cách nào.

segments.src: Whatever the outcome, the debate is likely to shape defense budgets and deficit discussions for years.
segments.tr: Dù kết quả thế nào, cuộc tranh luận có khả năng định hình ngân sách quốc phòng và các cuộc thảo luận về thâm hụt trong nhiều năm.

segments.src: Readers who want to understand it should look past the headline total and ask what the money buys, who decides, and who ultimately pays.
segments.tr: Độc giả muốn hiểu điều đó nên nhìn xa hơn tổng số trên tiêu đề và hỏi xem số tiền đó mua được gì, ai quyết định và ai là người cuối cùng chi trả.
